daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb (fiʿl amr); the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta), and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اللَّهُمَّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, with the vocative particle yāʾ omitted and compensated for by the doubled mīm. ﴿مالِكَ﴾: a munādā, or a badal (substitute) from اللهم; there are other views on it besides these. ﴿الْمُلْكِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تُؤْتِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; the fāʿil is "you". ﴿الْمُلْكِ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿تَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). The clause ﴿تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ ... ﴾ is in the position of accusative (fī maḥall naṣb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from اللهم. ﴿وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشاءُ﴾: وتنزع الملك is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi; ممن: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنزع; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa), and the clause تشاء is the ṣila. ﴿وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشاءُ، وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشاءُ﴾: conjoined (ʿaṭf). ﴿بِيَدِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْخَيْرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾: inna and its noun; its khabar is قدير; شيء: muḍāf ilayhi; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير. ﴿تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهارِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تولج; the clause is resumptive, and likewise ﴿وَتُولِجُ النَّهارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾ is conjoined, and so too ﴿وَتُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ﴾ and ﴿وَتُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ﴾. ﴿وَتَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the fāʿil is "you", and the clause تشاء is the ṣila. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, the implied form being: «ترزق رزقا وافرا بغير حساب» (You provide abundant provision without reckoning). ﴿حِسابٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:28-28.t:
﴿لا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive. يتخذ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أولياء. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَفْعَلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "he" (huwa). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فَلَيْسَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ليس﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (huwa). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by مِن; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from شيء, because it precedes it. ﴿فِي شَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ليس. The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of مَن. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ تَتَّقُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdar-forming أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied form is: «إلا تقية». [Translator's note: so in the source; the wording combines a genitive position after a preposition with an absolute object.] ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تتقوا. ﴿تُقاةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil, the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi, and نفسه is the second mafʿūl bihi. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تُخْفُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي صُدُورِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ﴾: conjoined to إن تخفوا ما. ﴿يَعْلَمْهُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the relative ما is its mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila; and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to ما في السموات. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and قدير is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:30-30.t:
﴿يَوْمَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ما عَمِلَتْ﴾: تجد is an imperfect verb, كل is the fāʿil (agent), the relative noun ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and نفس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). عملت: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause عملت is the ṣila (relative clause), having no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مُحْضَراً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَما عَمِلَتْ مِنْ سُوءٍ﴾: conjoined to ﴿ما عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾, and the clause عملت is the ṣila. ﴿تَوَدُّ﴾: an imperfect verb; the fāʿil is "she" (hiya), and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿أَنَّ بَيْنَها وَبَيْنَهُ أَمَداً﴾: أنّ, and أمدا is its noun; بينها is an adverb attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and بينه is conjoined to بينها. أنّ and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing). The apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted, its implied form being: «لسعدت بذلك» (she would be glad of that). ﴿بَعِيداً﴾: naʿt (adjective).
﴿وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿وَاللَّهُ رَؤُفٌ بِالْعِبادِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ and رؤوف is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar رؤوف; and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:141-142.t:
﴿وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied "an" after the lām of purpose; the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent) and the relative noun is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. The clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿وَيَمْحَقَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ is conjoined to «وليمحص». ﴿أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ﴾: «أم» is a conjunction; «حسبتم» is a past verb and its agent. ﴿أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ﴾ stands in place of the two objects of «حسبتم»; the implied sense is: "Do not think [you will have] entry into Paradise."
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «لما» is a jussive particle. ﴿يَعْلَمِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn, given a kasra because two quiescent letters meet. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Divine Name is its agent. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: its direct object, and the clause ﴿جاهَدُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. The clause ﴿وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَعْلَمَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾: the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya); «يعلم» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied "an" after the wāw of accompaniment, and the agent is «هو» [he]; «الصابرين» is a direct object, accusative with yāʾ. "An" and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to an interpreted maṣdar taken from the preceding verb; the implied sense is: "and Allah has not yet known the strivers and the patient."

daas-irab:143-143.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the response to an oath; «قد» is a particle of realization; «كنتم» is kāna and its noun (ism). ﴿تَمَنَّوْنَ الْمَوْتَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم». ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تمنون». ﴿أَنْ تَلْقَوْهُ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdar-particle and the verb is in the position of genitive by being the muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; «رأيتموه» is a past verb, its agent and its direct object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ﴾: [«أنتم» is] a mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause is its predicate; the clause ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:144-144.t:
﴿وَما مُحَمَّدٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is negating; «محمد» ﷺ is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: «خلت» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because two quiescent letters met; the tāʾ is for the feminine; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الرُّسُلُ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَفَإِنْ﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, the fāʾ is conjunctive, and «إن» is conditional. ﴿ماتَ﴾: a past verb whose agent is latent (mustatir); it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿أَوْ قُتِلَ﴾: a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is conjoined to «مات». ﴿انْقَلَبْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى أَعْقابِكُمْ﴾: attached to «انقلبتم», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being "apostatizing (مرتدين)", or to the verb «انقلبتم». [Translator's note: the source lists attachment to «انقلبتم» twice.] ﴿وَمَنْ يَنْقَلِبْ﴾: «من» is conditional; «ينقلب» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). ﴿عَلى عَقِبَيْهِ﴾: attached to «ينقلب»; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis. ﴿لن﴾: a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿يَضُرَّ اللَّهَ شَيْئاً﴾: an imperfect verb; the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the agent is latent. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وَسَيَجْزِي اللَّهُ الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾: the sīn is for the future; [then] an imperfect verb, its agent, and its direct object, accusative with yāʾ because it is a masculine plural; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:145-145.t: ﴿وَما﴾: «ما» is negating; the wāw is resumptive. ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِنَفْسٍ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿أَنْ تَمُوتَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as its noun (ism). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied sense is "that it die being permitted to." ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كِتاباً﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "كتب" [He wrote]. ﴿مُؤَجَّلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَمَنْ يُرِدْ ثَوابَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يرد» is an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and «ثواب» is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُؤْتِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; the agent is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is its direct object; the preposition and genitive noun ﴿مِنْها﴾ are attached to it. ﴿وَمَنْ يُرِدْ ثَوابَ الْآخِرَةِ نُؤْتِهِ مِنْها﴾ has already been parsed, and the i'rab of ﴿وَسَنَجْزِي الشَّاكِرِينَ﴾ has preceded.

daas-irab:146-146.t: ﴿وَكَأَيِّنْ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; «كأين» means the predicative «كم» [how many!], indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ نَبِيٍّ﴾: «من» is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; «نبي» is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the tamyīz (specification) of «كأين». ﴿قاتَلَ مَعَهُ﴾: a past verb to which the adverb is attached. ﴿رِبِّيُّونَ﴾: its fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَثِيرٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَما وَهَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its agent, with «ما» negating; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿لِما﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وهنوا», and the clause ﴿أَصابَهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: attached to «أصابهم». ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما ضَعُفُوا وَمَا اسْتَكانُوا﴾: conjoined to «ما وهنوا». ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يحب الصابرين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:147-148.t:
﴿وَما كانَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «ما» is negating; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿قَوْلَهُمْ﴾: its khabar (predicate), placed first. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ قالُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as the noun (ism) of kāna. ﴿رَبَّنَا﴾: a munādā (one addressed) in a genitive construct (muḍāf). ﴿اغْفِرْ لَنا ذُنُوبَنا﴾: a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and «ذنوبنا» is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech quoted by «قال» (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِسْرافَنا﴾: conjoined to «ذنوبنا». ﴿فِي أَمْرِنا﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) «إسرافنا». ﴿وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدامَنا﴾: conjoined to ﴿اغْفِرْ لَنا ذُنُوبَنا﴾. ﴿وَانْصُرْنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَى الْقَوْمِ﴾: attached to «انصرنا». ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فَآتاهُمُ اللَّهُ ثَوابَ﴾: a past verb; the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ and «ثواب» are its two objects. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَحُسْنَ ثَوابِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «حسن» is conjoined to the first «ثواب», and the «ثواب» after it is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: like «والله يحب الصابرين» before it.

daas-irab:149-150.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has recurred [before]. ﴿إِنْ تُطِيعُوا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: «كفروا» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the relative noun is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «تطيعوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the conditional «إن», and the wāw is the agent. ﴿يَرُدُّوكُمْ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent and the kāf is the direct object; attached to this verb is the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلى أَعْقابِكُمْ﴾. ﴿فَتَنْقَلِبُوا خاسِرِينَ﴾: conjoined to «يردوكم», and ﴿خاسِرِينَ﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with yāʾ. The clause «يردوكم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ.
﴿بَلِ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَوْلاكُمْ﴾: the khabar (predicate), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: khabar. ﴿النَّاصِرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:151-151.t: ﴿سَنُلْقِي﴾: the sīn is for the future; «نلقي» is an imperfect verb and the fāʿil (agent) is «نحن» [We]. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نلقي». ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَفَرُوا الرُّعْبَ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. [Translator's note: so in the source; «الرعب» is actually the object of «نلقي», «كفروا» alone being the ṣila.] ﴿بِما أَشْرَكُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition; [the preposition and its noun] are attached to «نلقي». ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name is genitive, and [the preposition and noun] are attached to «أشركوا». ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as a direct object. ﴿لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم». ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: the object of «ينزل». ﴿وَمَأْواهُمُ النَّارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿بِئْسَ مَثْوَى الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; «مثوى» is the agent, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because [its appearance] is impossible; «الظالمين» is muḍāf ilayhi. The one specifically blamed (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "the Fire"; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:152-152.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an oath, and «قد» is a particle of realization. ﴿صَدَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَعْدَهُ﴾: a second direct object. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صدقكم»; the clause is the response to the omitted oath. ﴿تَحُسُّونَهُمْ بِإِذْنِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and its direct object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تحسونهم», i.e. "you were slaying them up to this time"; it is also said that «حتى» is a particle of beginning (ibtidāʾ). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of future time, attached to the apodosis (jawāb). ﴿فَشِلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَنازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَعَصَيْتُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: attached to «عصيتم». ﴿ما أَراكُمْ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdar-particle «ما» and the verb is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما تُحِبُّونَ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the second object of «أراكم», and the clause «تحبون» is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ يُرِيدُ﴾: «من» is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يُرِيدُ الدُّنْيا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; parsed like it is ﴿وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ﴾. ﴿ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction; «صرفكم» is a past verb and its direct object, and the agent is «هو» [He]; «عنهم» is attached to «صرفكم»; the clause is conjoined to the implied apodosis of «إذا». ﴿لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied maṣdar-particle «أن» after the lām of purpose and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «صرفكم». ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the response to an oath, «قد» is a particle of realization. ﴿عَفا عَنْكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is the response to the oath. ﴿وَاللَّهُ ذُو﴾: «الله», the Divine Name, is the mubtadaʾ; «ذو» is the khabar, nominative with wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns. ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: attached to «فضل»; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:31-32.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ﴾: إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. كنتم: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause تحبون is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ... ﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاتَّبِعُونِي﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿اتبعوني﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿يُحْبِبْكُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command اتبعوني; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil.
﴿وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ﴾: conjoined to ﴿يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور and رحيم are its two predicates; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive, and ﴿أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَالرَّسُولَ﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive, and تولوا is an imperfect verb from which a tāʾ has been dropped; the wāw is the fāʿil, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). Or it is a past verb ... and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يُحِبُّ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ ... ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:33-34.t:
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿اصْطَفى آدَمَ﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَنُوحاً وَآلَ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: conjoined to آدم; إبراهيم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a proper noun and foreign. ﴿وَآلَ عِمْرانَ﴾: conjoined; عمران is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with a fatḥa because it is a proper noun ending in alif and nūn. ﴿عَلَى الْعالَمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb اصطفى; and the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ ... ﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿ذُرِّيَّةً﴾: a badal (substitute) from نوح.., accusative with the fatḥa; or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بَعْضُها﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ بَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ذرية. [Translator's note: so in the source, "in the position of genitive", although ذريةً is accusative.] ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, with its two predicates; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:35-36.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "اذكر" (remember). ﴿قالَتِ امْرَأَتُ عِمْرانَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); عمران is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ﴾: inna, and the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause نذرت is its khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نذرت. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي بَطْنِي﴾: a genitive noun whose sign of the genitive is a kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مُحَرَّراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), or a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, its implied form being «غلاما محررا» (a dedicated boy). ﴿فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, or it is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿فَتَقَبَّلْ﴾: a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), and the fāʿil is "you" (anta). ﴿مِنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقبل. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾: the two predicates of أنت, and the nominal clause is the khabar of inna; the clause ﴿إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ ... ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لمّا is adverbial and conditional. ﴿وَضَعَتْها﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "she" (hiya); the clause is the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: a munādā, muḍāf, accusative. ﴿إِنِّي وَضَعْتُها﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause وضعتها is its khabar. ﴿أُنْثى﴾: a badal (substitute) from the hāʾ in وضعتها, or a ḥāl. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِما وَضَعَتْ﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya); the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ and أعلم is the khabar, and the clause is parenthetical. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعلم, and the clause ﴿وَضَعَتْ﴾ is the ṣila, having no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنْثى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ليس الذكر: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; كالأنثى: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined to ﴿وَضَعْتُها أُنْثى﴾. ﴿وَإِنِّي سَمَّيْتُها مَرْيَمَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause سميتها is the khabar. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُها﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause أعيذها is its khabar; the clause ﴿إِنِّي أُعِيذُها﴾ is conjoined. ﴿بِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعيذها. ﴿وَذُرِّيَّتَها﴾: conjoined to the hāʾ in أعيذها. ﴿مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعيذها. ﴿الرَّجِيمِ﴾: naʿt.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿فَتَقَبَّلَها رَبُّها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ربها is the fāʿil (agent). It has also been read in the accusative, as a vocative (nidāʾ), i.e. «تقبلها يا ربها» (accept her, O her Lord). ﴿بِقَبُولٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقبل. ﴿حَسَنٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَأَنْبَتَها نَباتاً حَسَناً﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and نباتا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾: naʿt. ﴿وَكَفَّلَها زَكَرِيَّا﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi and زكريا its second mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), implied as "Allah"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّما﴾: an adverb attached to the apodosis (jawāb), which is the verb وجد, and the clause ﴿دَخَلَ﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿دَخَلَ عَلَيْها زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرابَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to دخل. ﴿وَجَدَ عِنْدَها رِزْقاً﴾: a past verb, the fāʿil being "he" (huwa), and its object; the adverb is attached to وجد, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from رزقا. The clause is the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا مَرْيَمُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma. ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَتْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾: هو is mubtadaʾ; من عند: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يرزق is its khabar; من is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause), having no grammatical position. ﴿بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرزق; and the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ ... ﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:153-153.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرفكم»; it is also said [attached] to an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember (اذكروا)". ﴿تُصْعِدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا تَلْوُونَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, «لا» is negating, and «تلوون» is conjoined to «تصعدون». ﴿عَلى أَحَدٍ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «يدعوكم» is an imperfect verb and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي أُخْراكُمْ﴾: attached to «يدعوكم»; the clause «يدعوكم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الرسول». ﴿فَأَثابَكُمْ غَمًّا بِغَمٍّ﴾: «أثابكم» is a past verb and a first direct object, its agent latent (mustatir); «غما» is a second direct object or a tamyīz (specification); «بغم» is attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «غما»; the clause is conjoined to the clause «تصعدون». ﴿لِكَيْلا تَحْزَنُوا﴾: the lām is a preposition; «كي» is a maṣdar-particle that makes the verb accusative; «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), negating, with no governing effect; «تحزنوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. ﴿عَلى ما فاتَكُمْ﴾: attached to «تحزنوا», and the clause «فاتكم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلا ما أَصابَكُمْ﴾: conjoined to «ما فاتكم». ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction; «أنزل» is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq), and also the preposition and genitive noun ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾; the clause is conjoined to «أصابكم». ﴿الْغَمِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَمَنَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نُعاساً﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿يَغْشى طائِفَةً مِنْكُمْ﴾: «طائفة» is the direct object of the imperfect verb «يغشى»; «منكم» is attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «طائفة». ﴿وَطائِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object, and «أنفسهم» is the fāʿil (agent); «قد» is a particle of realization; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «طائفة», and the clause ﴿وَطائِفَةٌ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿يَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its agent; «بالله» is attached to «يظنون»; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the implied sense is: "they think a thought other than the true thought." ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ظَنَّ الْجاهِلِيَّةِ﴾: a badal of «غير», accusative with fatḥa. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle. ﴿لَنا﴾: attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْرِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: «من» is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and a noun genitive in form, nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; the clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُ لِلَّهِ﴾: «قل» has been parsed before; «إن الأمر لله»: inna and its noun (ism); «كله» is tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name is genitive, and [the preposition and noun] are attached to the khabar of inna; the clause is the speech quoted, and the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive.
﴿يُخْفُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and genitive noun «في أنفسهم» are attached, and the wāw is the agent; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿ما لا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative «ما». ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ كانَ لَنا﴾: «لو» is a non-jussive conditional, and the rest of the clause is like the clause «ليس لك من الأمر شيء». [Translator's note: so in the source; the comparison intended is evidently with «هل لنا من الأمر من شيء» parsed above.] ﴿ما قُتِلْنا هاهُنا﴾: «ما» is negating; the hāʾ is for drawing attention; «هنا» is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb, attached to the passive past verb before it; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun, and the preposition and genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is the speech quoted. ﴿لَبَرَزَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun is the agent; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَتْلُ﴾: «القتل» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِلى مَضاجِعِهِمْ﴾: attached to «برز». ﴿وَلِيَبْتَلِيَ اللَّهُ ما فِي صُدُورِكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن»; the Divine Name is its agent and the relative «ما» its object; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did that in order to test (عمل ذلك ليبتلي)". «في صدوركم» is attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ما فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾: conjoined to «وليبتلي الله». ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ and «عليم» the khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun ﴿بِذاتِ﴾ are attached; «الصدور» is muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:155-155.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا﴾: inna and its noun (ism), and the clause «تولوا» is its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied sense is "routed, from among you." ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb attached to «تولوا». ﴿الْتَقَى الْجَمْعانِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative with alif because it is a dual; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّمَا اسْتَزَلَّهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: a past verb, its object and its agent; «إنما» is [inna] with the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause is the khabar of inna. «ببعض»: attached to «استزلهم». ﴿ما كَسَبُوا﴾: «ما» is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of realization; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun, and «غفور» and «حليم» are its two predicates; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:156-156.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has recurred [before]. ﴿لا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: «لا» is the prohibitive, jussive-making [particle]; «تكونوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun (ism); «كالذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate), or the kāf may be parsed as a noun meaning "like (مثل)", which is the khabar; the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَقالُوا لِإِخْوانِهِمْ﴾: conjoined to «كفروا». ﴿إِذا ضَرَبُوا﴾: «إذا» is an adverb of time attached to «قالوا», and the clause after it is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to «ضربوا». ﴿أَوْ كانُوا غُزًّى﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَوْ كانُوا عِنْدَنا﴾: «لو» is conditional, [then] kāna and its noun, and the adverb is attached to the khabar. ﴿ما ماتُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), with «ما» negating; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «لو»; the clause ﴿لَوْ كانُوا﴾ is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما قُتِلُوا﴾: like «ما كانوا», and the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: so in the source; «ما ماتوا» is evidently meant.] ﴿لِيَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ ذلِكَ حَسْرَةً﴾: the lām is the lām of outcome (al-ʿāqiba), and [then] an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of outcome; the Divine Name is its agent, the demonstrative its first object and «حسرة» its second object; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied «أن» and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قالوا». ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: attached to «حسرة», or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُحْيِي﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive, and the clause «يحيي» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الله»; the clause ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ «بصير»: the nominal clause is resumptive, and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿بِما﴾ are attached to «بصير». ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:157-158.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa); «إن» is a jussive conditional. ﴿قُتِلْتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قتلتم». ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ مُتُّمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَمَغْفِرَةٌ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath. ﴿مغفرة﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name is genitive, and [the preposition and noun] are attached to «مغفرة». ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مغفرة»; the clause is the response to the oath, and it suffices in place of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) because [the oath] precedes it, for when a condition and an oath come together the response belongs to the one that comes first. ﴿مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خير». ﴿وَلَئِنْ مُتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ﴾: the like of «ولئن متم» has preceded; «أو قتلتم» is conjoined to «متم»; «لإلى الله»: the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the passive verb after it; the clause is the response to the oath.

daas-irab:159-159.t: ﴿فَبِما رَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; the bāʾ is a preposition; «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); «رحمة» is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «لنت»; «لهم» is attached to the verb «لنت»; «من الله»: the Divine Name is in the position of genitive, and [the preposition and noun] are attached to «رحمة»; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «لو» is a non-jussive conditional; [then] kāna, its noun (ism) and its two predicates (khabar); «القلب» is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَانْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and [then] a past verb to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition]; «اعف» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is «أنت» [you]; «عنهم» is attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ﴾: the two clauses are conjoined, and the clause ﴿اعف﴾ is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إذا» is an adverb of future time, attached to «توكل». ﴿عَزَمْتَ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause ﴿فَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun, and the clause «يحب المتوكلين» is its khabar; the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:160-160.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional. ﴿يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the Divine Name its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَلا غالِبَ لَكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لا» is the lā of generic negation; «غالب» is its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «لا»; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ﴾: conjoined to «إن ينصركم». ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; «من» is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذَا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as khabar. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as badal (substitute). ﴿يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its agent; the preposition and its genitive noun, made of the Divine Name and the preposition, are attached to «يتوكل»; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:161-161.t: ﴿وَما كانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; «لنبي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna; «أن يغل»: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as the noun (ism) of kāna. ﴿وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ﴾: «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يغلل» is an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «يأت» is an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من»; the clause ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿بِما غَلَّ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar from the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «يأت», and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative «ما». [Translator's note: so in the source, which mixes the maṣdar and relative readings of «ما».] ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb attached to «يأت». ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ تُوَفَّى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ما كَسَبَتْ﴾: «توفى» is a passive imperfect verb; «كل» is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and the relative noun «ما» is the second object; «نفس» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «كسبت» is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause «توفى» is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ and the clause ﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:162-163.t: ﴿أَفَمَنِ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اتَّبَعَ رِضْوانَ اللَّهِ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كَمَنْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿باءَ بِسَخَطٍ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name is genitive, and [the preposition and noun] are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «سخط». ﴿وَمَأْواهُ جَهَنَّمُ﴾: a mubtadaʾ, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; «جهنم» is the khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «بئس» is a past verb for expressing blame; «المصير» is its agent, and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being "Hell"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هُمْ دَرَجاتٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted adjective of «درجات». ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ and «بصير» the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾: attached to «بصير», and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:164-165.t: ﴿لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of realization; the clause is the response to the oath, or resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منّ». ﴿بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and «رسولا» is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «رسولا». ﴿يَتْلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ آياتِهِ﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of «رسولا». ﴿وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾: conjoined to ﴿يَتْلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾. ﴿وَإِنْ كانُوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «إن» is lightened [from inna] with no governing effect; [then] kāna and its noun (ism). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: «قبل» is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the genitive construct, in the position of genitive by «من»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَفِي ضَلالٍ﴾: the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كانوا». ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: an adjective; the clause ﴿وَإِنْ كانُوا ... ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿أَوَلَمَّا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw is conjunctive; «لما» is an adverb meaning "when (حين)", attached to «قلتم». ﴿أَصابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ﴾: a past verb, a direct object and the agent; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِثْلَيْها﴾: a past verb and its agent; «مثليها» is a direct object, accusative with yāʾ because it is a dual; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective of «مصيبة». ﴿قُلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as a khabar placed first. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: «هو» is a mubtadaʾ; «من عند» is attached to an omitted khabar; «أنفسكم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech quoted, and the clause «قل» is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun and «قدير» as its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar «قدير»; «شيء» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:38-39.t: ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative (fī maḥall naṣb) as an adverb of time or place; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿دَعا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative. [Translator's note: so in the source; in the ayah ربَّه is the object of دعا, and the analysis as munādā probably belongs to the implied «ربِّ» of the supplication that follows.] ﴿هَبْ﴾: a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ) whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb هب. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هب, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ذرية. ﴿ذُرِّيَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿طَيِّبَةً﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعاءِ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); الدعاء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿فَنادَتْهُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil; نادته is indeclinable on a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَهُوَ قائِمٌ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl, and the clause ﴿يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرابِ﴾ is a ḥāl or a second khabar. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيى﴾: anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يبشرك is the khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يبشرك. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿بِكَلِمَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مصدقا. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by مِن; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted naʿt of كلمة. ﴿وَسَيِّداً وَحَصُوراً وَنَبِيًّا﴾: conjoined to مصدقا. ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾. The nominal clause ﴿وَهُوَ قائِمٌ ... ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; and anna, its noun and its khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نادته; the implied form is: «نادته ببشارة الله» (they called him with Allah's glad tidings).

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa), and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle. ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَكُونُ﴾: a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb. ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يكون. ﴿غُلامٌ﴾: the fāʿil of يكون, nominative; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the nominal clause ﴿وَامْرَأَتِي عاقِرٌ﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or to an omitted khabar (predicate), the implied form being: «الأمر كذلك» (the matter is thus). And the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَفْعَلُ ما يَشاءُ﴾: the clause is the khabar, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause); and the clause ﴿قالَ كَذلِكَ اللَّهُ..﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf. ﴿اجْعَلْ لِي آيَةً﴾: a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and آية is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اجعل; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿آيَتُكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdar-forming أن and the verb is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the implied form is: «آيتك عدم التكلم» (your sign is not speaking). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثَلاثَةَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to the verb before it. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has إِلَّا here.] ﴿رَمْزاً﴾: the excepted (mustathnā), accusative. ﴿وَاذْكُرْ رَبَّكَ كَثِيراً﴾: an imperative verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and كثيرا stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكارِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb سبح, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).

daas-irab:42-43.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "اذكر" (remember). ﴿قالَتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يا مَرْيَمُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفاكِ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; اصطفاك is a past verb and its object, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause إن الله is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفاكِ﴾: conjoined to the first اصطفاك. ﴿عَلى نِساءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اصطفاك. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ. ﴿يا مَرْيَمُ﴾: the yāʾ is a vocative particle standing in place of "أدعو" (I call); مريم is a munādā, a singular proper noun. ﴿اقْنُتِي﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ of the female addressee is in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿لِرَبِّكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اقنتي. ﴿وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي﴾: conjoined to اقنتي. ﴿مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ﴾: مع is an adverb of place attached to the verb اركعي, and الراكعين is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we" (naḥnu); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نوحي, and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative; كان, and the tāʾ is its noun; لديهم: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of كنت. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, also attached to an omitted khabar; the implied form is: «وما كنت مستقرا إذ ...» (you were not present when ...). ﴿يُلْقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَقْلامَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَيُّهُمْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ﴾ is its khabar. The clause ﴿أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ ... ﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وَما كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾: conjoined to the first clause ﴿وَما كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ﴾, and it is like it in its i'rab.

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿إِذْ قالَتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: إذ is a badal (substitute) from إذ in the previous ayah, and the clause after it is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يا مَرْيَمُ﴾: يا is a vocative particle; مريم is the one addressed (munādā), a proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يبشرك is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يبشرك; and the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ ... ﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كلمة. ﴿اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿عِيسَى﴾: badal. ﴿ابْنُ﴾: naʿt or badal. ﴿مَرْيَمُ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) because it is a proper noun and foreign. The clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of كلمة. ﴿وَجِيهاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from كلمة, because it has been qualified. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وجيها. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, its implied form being: «ومقدما من المقربين» (and advanced among those brought near). ﴿وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ﴾: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa); في المهد: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil: «ويكلم الناس رضيعا في المهد» (and he will speak to people as a nursling in the cradle). ﴿وَكَهْلًا﴾: conjoined to the implied رضيعا. ﴿وَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl as well.

daas-irab:47-47.t:
﴿قالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ﴾: see its i'rab at ayah 40. ﴿وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); يمسسني is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and its sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and بشر is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). [Translator's note: so in the source; يمسسْني is in fact jussive with the sukūn, as no nūn of the five verbs is involved.] ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿كَذلِكِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: «الشأن كذلك» (the matter is thus); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ ما يَشاءُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and the clause يخلق is its khabar, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause). The clause ﴿اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ﴾ is resumptive.
﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time. ﴿قَضى أَمْراً﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "he" (huwa), and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿إنما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and the clause ﴿يَقُولُ لَهُ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not make the verb jussive.
﴿كُنْ﴾: a complete (tāmm) imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you" (anta), and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; يكون is a complete imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: «فهو يكون» (so it is), and the clause فهو يكون is resumptive.

daas-irab:48-49.t:
﴿وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتابَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يعلمه is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْراةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ﴾: conjoined to الكتاب; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَرَسُولًا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رسولا is a noun conjoined to وجيها, or the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e. «ويجعله رسولا» (and He will make him a messenger), so the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى بَنِي﴾: بني is a noun, genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper noun and foreign. ﴿أَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ﴾: anna, and the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause is its khabar (predicate). Anna, its noun and its khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) رسولا. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئتكم. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية. ﴿أَنِّي أَخْلُقُ لَكُمْ﴾: anna and its noun, and the clause أخلق is its khabar; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being: «مبرهنا لكم» (giving you proof). ﴿مِنَ الطِّينِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخلق; and anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) from آية, or as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هي" (it is). ﴿كَهَيْئَةِ﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, and هيئة is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الطَّيْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَنْفُخُ فِيهِ﴾: conjoined to أخلق. ﴿فَيَكُونُ طَيْراً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he/it" (huwa), and طيرا is its khabar. ﴿بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a naʿt of طير, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ﴾: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "I" (anā), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأُحْيِ الْمَوْتى بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾: conjoined; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِما تَأْكُلُونَ﴾: بما: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb أنبئكم; the clause is conjoined, and the clause تأكلون is the ṣila (relative clause), having no grammatical position.
﴿وَما تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً﴾: inna, and لآية is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and في ذلك: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of آية. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the conditional particle in the ayah is إِنْ.] ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective past verb, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its khabar, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: «إن كنتم مؤمنين اعتبرتم» (if you are believers, you will take heed).

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿وَمُصَدِّقاً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مصدقا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "جئتكم" (I have come to you). ﴿لِما﴾: the lām is a preposition and ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) مصدقا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَدَيَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual, the nūn having been dropped for the annexation, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنَ التَّوْراةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَلِأُحِلَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and أحل is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "وجئتكم" (and I have come to you). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحل. ﴿بَعْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿حُرِّمَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it" (huwa). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حرم, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَجِئْتُكُمْ بِآيَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: for its i'rab see the previous ayah. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e. "if you believe after the signs I have mentioned to you, then fear Allah"; اتقوا is an imperative and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not make the verb jussive, having no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:51-52.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and ربي is the khabar (predicate), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. ﴿فَاعْبُدُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); اعبدوه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition: «إذا كان الله ربي فاعبدوه» (since Allah is my Lord, worship Him), having no grammatical position. ﴿هذا صِراطٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لمّا is adverbial and conditional. ﴿أَحَسَّ عِيسى مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun منهم are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحس or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الكفر; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿مَنْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَنْصارِي﴾: khabar, nominative with a ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to أنصاري; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ الْحَوارِيُّونَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَحْنُ أَنْصارُ اللَّهِ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to آمنا; the clause is resumptive, or a second khabar of نحن, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; اشهد is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you" (anta). بأنا مسلمون: the bāʾ is a preposition, and anna, its noun and its khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اشهد. The clause اشهد is resumptive.

daas-irab:53-54.t: ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle; it is muḍāf, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا. ﴿أَنْزَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to آمنا. ﴿فَاكْتُبْنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e. "since we have believed, then record us"; a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ) and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ﴾: attached to اكتبنا. ﴿وَمَكَرُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; مكروا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and خير is the khabar (predicate), and ﴿الْماكِرِينَ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:55-55.t:
﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿قالَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يا عِيسى﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and عيسى is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وَرافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ﴾: conjoined to متوفيك; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to رافعك. ﴿وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: مطهرك is conjoined, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مطهرك; [كفروا is] a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَجاعِلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوكَ﴾: جاعل is conjoined, and الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation; [اتبعوك is] a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the omitted second object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: in the position of genitive by annexation, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the active participle جاعل. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; مرجعكم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and بينكم is an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿فِيما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحكم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause is the ṣila, having no grammatical position. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb after them. ﴿تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

daas-irab:56-57.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أمّا is a particle of condition, detailing and emphasis. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); أعذبهم is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "I" (anā); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين. ﴿عَذاباً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعذبهم. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَما لَهُمْ مِنْ ناصِرِينَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; مِن is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ناصرين is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: conjoined to فأما الذين كفروا, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of أمّا, and يوفيهم is an imperfect verb and a first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُجُورَهُمْ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause والله لا يحب الظالمين is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَتْلُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْآياتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl as well. ﴿وَالذِّكْرِ﴾: conjoined to الآيات. ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾: naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿ذلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), having no grammatical position.

daas-irab:59-60.t:
﴿إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾: inna and its noun; عيسى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddara) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur); عند is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿آدَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper noun and foreign. The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿خَلَقَهُ مِنْ تُرابٍ﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خلقه. ﴿ثُمَّ قالَ لَهُ﴾: conjoined to خلقه. ﴿كُنْ﴾: a complete (tāmm) imperative verb; the fāʿil is "you" (anta), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾: a complete imperfect verb, and the clause is conjoined.
﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; or الحق is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: «ما قلناه لك عن عيسى هو الحق» (what We have told you about Jesus is the truth), and من ربك is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلا تَكُنْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e. «إذا كان هذا هو الحق فلا تكن» (if this is the truth, then do not be); لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; تكن is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you" (anta); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of تكن.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حَاجَّكَ فِيهِ﴾: the clause is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); حاجك is a past verb, the kāf is its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. [Translator's note: so in the source; the kāf is "you", and the fāʿil of حاجّك is the latent "he" (huwa) referring to مَن.] ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ ما جاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾: من بعد is attached to حاجك, and من العلم is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "clarified by knowledge"; and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَقُلْ تَعالَوْا نَدْعُ أَبْناءَنا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of the request; تعالوا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ندع: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the clause تعالوا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَبْناءَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأَبْناءَكُمْ ... إلخ﴾ (etc.): conjoined to أبناءنا. ﴿ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ﴾: conjoined to ندع, jussive with the sukūn. ﴿فَنَجْعَلْ﴾: conjoined to نبتهل. ﴿لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَى﴾ الكافرين: لعنة is a mafʿūl bihi; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); على الكافرين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb نجعل.

daas-irab:62-63.t:
﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); هو القصص: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); or هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and القصص is the khabar of inna; الحق is a naʿt (adjective) of القصص. ﴿وَما مِنْ إِلهٍ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; مِن is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; إله is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, khabar, nominative; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the shifted lām; هو is mubtadaʾ, and العزيز الحكيم are two predicates of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause وإن is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾: تولوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم.

daas-irab:166-167.t:
﴿وَما أَصابَكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أصابكم» is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أصابكم». ﴿الْتَقَى الْجَمْعانِ﴾: a past verb; «الجمعان» is the fāʿil (agent), nominative with alif because it is a dual; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the response to the relative noun because of its resemblance to a condition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from an implied «أن» after the lām of purpose and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to «بإذن». ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with yāʾ. ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نافَقُوا﴾: «وليعلم» has been parsed before. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, direct object; the clause is conjoined to ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾, and the clause ﴿نافَقُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is «هو» [it], referring to the maṣdar of the verb; it is also said that the deputy agent is the two clauses ﴿تَعالَوْا قاتِلُوا ... ﴾. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: attached to «قيل». [Translator's note: so in the source; «في سبيل الله» is normally attached to «قاتلوا».] ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أَوِ ادْفَعُوا﴾: conjoined to «قاتلوا»; like it, an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتالًا﴾: «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle, and [then] an imperfect verb and its object, the agent being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form «نحن» [we]; the clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَاتَّبَعْناكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its direct object; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, and the lām occurs in its apodosis. ﴿هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمانِ﴾: «هم أقرب» is mubtadaʾ and khabar, to which [i.e. to «أقرب»] are attached the preposition and genitive noun «للكفر» and «منهم», and likewise the adverb «يومئذ»; ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb of time attached to «أقرب»; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and given a kasra because two quiescent letters meet. ﴿لِلْإِيمانِ﴾: also attached to «أقرب».
