﴿يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْواهِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun, direct object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «ليس»; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِما يَكْتُمُونَ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ and «أعلم» the khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun are attached; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «يكتمون» is the ṣila of «ما».

daas-irab:168-168.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هم» [they], or as a badal (substitute) for the wāw in «يكتمون»; the nominal clause ﴿هم الذين﴾ is resumptive, and the clause ﴿قالُوا لِإِخْوانِهِمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَقَعَدُوا﴾: conjoined to «قالوا»; it is also said that the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿لَوْ أَطاعُونا﴾: «لو» is conditional; [then] a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «لو» is a non-jussive conditional, and the clause is a direct object [of «قالوا»]. ﴿ما قُتِلُوا﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), with «ما» negating; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿فَادْرَؤُا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition], and [then] an imperative verb to which the preposition and genitive noun ﴿عَنْ أَنْفُسِكُمُ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its agent. ﴿الْمَوْتَ﴾: its object; the clause is the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition: "if you are truthful, then avert." ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾: «كنتم» is kāna and its noun (ism), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «صادقين» is its khabar; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:169-170.t: ﴿وَلا تَحْسَبَنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لا» is the prohibitive, jussive-making [particle]; «تحسبن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of jussive; the nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت» [you]. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُتِلُوا﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قتلوا». ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَمْواتاً﴾: second direct object. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَحْياءٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they are alive." ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «أحياء», or to «يرزقون». ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُرْزَقُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb and its deputy agent; the clause is an adjective of «أحياء», and it is also said [to be] a khabar. ﴿فَرِحِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with yāʾ. ﴿بِما آتاهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «فرحين»; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the Divine Name is the agent. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: attached to «آتاهم». ﴿وَيَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِالَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿لَمْ يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from the agent of «يلحقوا». ﴿أَلَّا خَوْفٌ﴾: «أن» is lightened from the heavy [anna], and its noun (ism) is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «لا خوف»: «لا» is negating and «خوف» is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿وَلا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and what follows it is conjoined; «أن», its noun and its khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal of «الذين».

daas-irab:171-172.t: ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «بنعمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name and the preposition are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «نعمة». ﴿وَفَضْلٍ﴾: conjoined to «نعمة»; the clause is resumptive, and it is also said [to be] a badal (substitute). ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: anna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism), and the clause is its khabar (predicate); «أن», its noun and its khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to «نعمة». ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as an adjective of «المؤمنين», or accusative by way of praise; the clause ﴿اسْتَجابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: attached to «استجابوا». ﴿ما أَصابَهُمُ﴾: «ما» is a maṣdar-particle, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from it and the verb after it is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَصابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the agent. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا مِنْهُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar placed first; the clause «أحسنوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun; «منهم» is attached to «أحسنوا». ﴿وَاتَّقَوْا﴾: conjoined to «أحسنوا». ﴿أَجْرٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: an adjective; the clause ﴿الَّذِينَ اسْتَجابُوا ... ﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:173-173.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a badal (substitute) of the «الذين» before it, and the clause ﴿قالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ﴾: inna and its noun (ism), and the clause «قد جمعوا لكم» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جمعوا». ﴿فَاخْشَوْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition]. ﴿اخشوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَزادَهُمْ إِيماناً﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and [then] a past verb and its first object, the agent being latent (mustatir); «إيمانا» is a second direct object or a tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: likewise conjoined. ﴿حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ﴾: «الله», the Divine Name, is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, and «حسبنا» is its khabar; the clause «الله حسبنا» is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise, and its agent; the one specifically praised (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being "He is Allah."

daas-irab:174-175.t: ﴿فَانْقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded in verse 171; the clause is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "they went out with their Prophet, and returned." ﴿لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ﴾: «لم» is jussive, and [then] an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا رِضْوانَ اللَّهِ﴾: a past verb, its agent and a direct object; the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذُو﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: [inna with] the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no grammatical position. ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِياءَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and a direct object, the agent being «هو» [he]; the clause is the khabar of «الشيطان», and the clause ﴿الشَّيْطانُ يُخَوِّفُ ... ﴾ is the khabar of «ذلكم»; it is also permissible to parse «الشيطان» as khabar, the clause after it being circumstantial or resumptive. ﴿فَلا تَخافُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you have believed in that, then do not fear them." ﴿تَخافُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, its agent and its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَخافُونِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive. ﴿خافُونِ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the speaker has been dropped optionally. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: its i'rab has recurred [before].

daas-irab:176-176.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and «لا» is prohibitive. ﴿يَحْزُنْكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿يُسارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيْئاً﴾: inna and its noun (ism); «يضروا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the wāw is the agent; «الله», the Divine Name, is its object; «شيئا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; the clause «لن يضروا» is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause ﴿إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يَضُرُّوا﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its agent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by «أن», with «لا» negating; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is in the position of accusative as a direct object. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object. ﴿حَظًّا﴾: first direct object. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «حظ». ﴿وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾: «عذاب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after and «عظيم» an adjective; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined or resumptive.

daas-irab:177-177.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, with the relative noun as its noun (ism). ﴿اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْإِيْمانِ﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); «الكفر» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿لَنْ يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيْئاً﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined or resumptive.

daas-irab:178-178.t: ﴿وَلا يَحْسَبَنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لا» is the prohibitive, jussive-making [particle]; «يحسبن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنَّما نُمْلِي لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ﴾: «أن» is a particle resembling the verb; «ما» is a maṣdar-particle; «نملي» is an imperfect verb and the agent is «نحن» [We]; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of anna; it is also permissible to parse «ما» as relative; «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; «خير» is the khabar (predicate) of anna. ﴿لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: attached to «خير»; anna, its noun and its khabar stand in place of the two objects of «يحسبن». ﴿أَنَّما نُمْلِي لَهُمْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيَزْدادُوا إِثْماً﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of purpose, and the wāw is its agent; «إثما» is a tamyīz (specification); the interpreted maṣdar from the verb «يزدادوا» and the implied «أن» is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نملي». ﴿وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ مُهِينٌ﴾: like «ولهم عذاب أليم» before it.

daas-irab:179-179.t: ﴿ما كانَ اللَّهُ﴾: «ما» is negating; kāna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism). ﴿لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd) preceded by a negation; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate): "intending to leave them." ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلى ما أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يذر». ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar; the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿حَتَّى يَمِيزَ الْخَبِيثَ﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit and a preposition; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied «أن» after «حتى» and the verb «يميز» is in the position of genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يذر». ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ﴾: attached to «يميز». ﴿وَما كانَ اللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ﴾: conjoined to ﴿ما كانَ اللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ ... ﴾ and parsed like it. ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْتَبِي﴾: lākinna, with the Divine Name as its noun, and the clause «يجتبي» is its khabar; the clause ﴿وَلكِنَّ ... ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ رُسُلِهِ﴾: attached to «حتى». [Translator's note: so in the source; it is evidently attached to «يجتبي».] ﴿مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: a relative noun, direct object, and the clause «يشاء» is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition], and [then] an imperative verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the Divine Name and the preposition are attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَرُسُلِهِ﴾: conjoined to «الله». ﴿وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «إن» is conditional; «تؤمنوا» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾: the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The fāʾ connects the apodosis; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; «أجر» is the mubtadaʾ and «عظيم» an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:64-64.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ تَعالَوْا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, and الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); تعالوا is an imperative and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى كَلِمَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تعالوا. ﴿سَواءٍ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾: an adverb attached to سواء. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾: conjoined to بيننا. ﴿أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that makes the verb accusative; لا is negative; نعبد is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is a badal (substitute) from كلمة; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئاً﴾: لا نشرك is conjoined to لا نعبد; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; شيئا is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا يَتَّخِذَ﴾: conjoined to لا نشرك. ﴿بَعْضُنا﴾: fāʿil. ﴿بَعْضاً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَرْباباً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتخذ, or to a naʿt of أرباب. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; تولوا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَقُولُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿اشْهَدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ﴾: anna, and نا is its noun; مسلمون is its khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اشهدوا.

daas-irab:65-66.t: ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِي إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: the lām is a preposition; ما is an interrogative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تحاجون. تحاجون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إبراهيم is a genitive noun, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper noun and foreign, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحاجون; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَتِ التَّوْراةُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative; أنزلت is a passive past verb, and التوراة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْإِنْجِيلُ﴾: conjoined to التوراة. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزلت. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negative. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to an implied clause: «ألا ترون فتعقلون» (do you not see, and so understand?). ﴿ها أَنْتُمْ هؤُلاءِ﴾: ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); أنتم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and هؤلاء is the khabar (predicate). ﴿حاجَجْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, and likewise the nominal clause before it. ﴿فِيما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before it. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of علم, because it precedes it. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَلِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِيما لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ﴾: لكم: attached to the omitted khabar of ليس; به: attached to an omitted ḥāl of علم; and علم is the noun of ليس, nominative; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ما. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and the clause يعلم is the khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the clause is its khabar; the clause وأنتم لا تعلمون is conjoined.

daas-irab:67-68.t: ﴿ما كانَ إِبْراهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا﴾: ما is negative, and كان, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَلا نَصْرانِيًّا﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿كانَ حَنِيفاً﴾: كان and its khabar, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he" (huwa). ﴿مُسْلِماً﴾: a second khabar. ﴿وَما كانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of كان, and its noun is a latent pronoun; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِإِبْراهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ﴾: أولى is the noun of inna and الذين is its khabar; الناس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); بإبراهيم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) أولى; اتبعوه: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَهذَا النَّبِيُّ﴾: هذا is a demonstrative conjoined to الذين; النبي is a badal (substitute) from هذا, nominative. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun conjoined to هذا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and ولي is the khabar; المتقين is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [Translator's note: so in the source, "المتقين"; the word in the ayah is الْمُؤْمِنِينَ.]

daas-irab:69-71.t: ﴿وَدَّتْ طائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ﴾: ودت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; طائفة is the fāʿil (agent); من أهل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ﴾: لو is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); يضلونكم is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi: «ودت إضلالكم» (they wished to mislead you). ﴿وَما يُضِلُّونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative; يضلون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); أنفسهم is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; يشعرون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ﴾: يا is for the vocative; أهل is accusative as the one addressed (munādā), and الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. لم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb تكفرون. ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to تكفرون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ﴾: أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause وأنتم تشهدون is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ الْحَقَّ بِالْباطِلِ﴾: its i'rab has already been given; بالباطل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تلبسون. ﴿وَتَكْتُمُونَ الْحَقَّ﴾: conjoined to لم تلبسون الحق. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the clause تعلمون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.

daas-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وَقالَتْ طائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قالت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; طائفة is the fāʿil (agent); من أهل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; and الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آمِنُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِالَّذِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them; and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "it" (huwa). ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل. ﴿آمِنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word in the ayah is the past verb آمَنُوا.]
﴿وَجْهَ﴾: an adverb attached to the imperative verb آمنوا. ﴿النَّهارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاكْفُرُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative and its fāʿil. ﴿آخِرَهُ﴾: an adverb of time attached to اكفروا. The clause is conjoined to the clause آمنوا, and the clause آمنوا with what follows it is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ﴾: laʿalla and its noun, and the verbal clause is its khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وَلا تُؤْمِنُوا﴾: لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive. تؤمنوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿لِمَنْ تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ﴾: لمن: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تؤمنوا; تبع دينكم: a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir). ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). ﴿إِنَّ الْهُدى هُدَى﴾: inna and its noun, and هدى is its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). And the clause ﴿أَنْ يُؤْتى أَحَدٌ مِثْلَ﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that makes the verb accusative; يؤتى is a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تؤمنوا. ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the first object; مثل is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ما أُوتِيتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause أوتيتم is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوْ يُحاجُّوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to يؤتى, accusative by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa), and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: عند is an adverb of place attached to يحاجوكم. ﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is parenthetical. ﴿إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ﴾: inna and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and the relative noun the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause يشاء is the ṣila, and the clause يؤتيه is a second khabar. ﴿وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and واسع and عليم are its two predicates; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: برحمته: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يختص; من is a relative noun in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause is a third khabar (predicate). ﴿وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and ذو is the khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is one of the five nouns (al-asmāʾ al-khamsa). الفضل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); العظيم is a naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the relative noun in the ayah is مَنْ.] ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَأْمَنْهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); it is jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿بِقِنْطارٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأمنه. ﴿يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤده. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينارٍ لا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿ما دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قائِماً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is its noun and قائما its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ قالُوا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; anna and its noun, and the clause قالوا is its khabar; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿لَيْسَ عَلَيْنا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ﴾: ليس is a defective past verb, and سبيل is its noun; علينا is attached to its omitted khabar; في الأميين is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to يقولون; and الكذب is a mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is mubtadaʾ, and the clause يعلمون is its khabar.

daas-irab:76-77.t: ﴿بَلى﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿مَنْ أَوْفى بِعَهْدِهِ﴾: من is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); أوفى is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوفى; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), having no grammatical position; بعهده is attached to أوفى. ﴿وَاتَّقى﴾: conjoined to أوفى. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يحب المتقين is its khabar (predicate); the clause فإن الله is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the condition and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. [Translator's note: so in the source, which first calls من a relative noun and then treats it as conditional.] ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يَشْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِعَهْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يشترون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأَيْمانِهِمْ﴾: conjoined to بعهد. ﴿ثَمَناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا خَلاقَ لَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation; خلاق is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; لهم is attached to an omitted khabar; في الآخرة is also attached to the omitted khabar; and the clause أولئك لا خلاق is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿وَلا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: لا is negative, and يكلم is an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its object and the Name of Majesty the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلا يُزَكِّيهِمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾: naʿt; and the clause is likewise conjoined. And the clause لا خلاق لهم is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:180-180.t:
﴿وَلا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ﴾: «يحسبن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive by the prohibitive «لا»; the clause is resumptive; the relative noun is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِما آتاهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Divine Name is the agent; the clause is the ṣila of the relative «ما», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يبخلون». ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: attached to «آتاهم». ﴿هُوَ خَيْراً لَهُمْ﴾: «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); «خيرا» is a second direct object, and it is said that the first object is omitted, its implied form being "the miserliness"; «لهم» is attached to «خيرا». ﴿بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), to which [the khabar] the preposition and genitive noun are attached; «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَيُطَوَّقُونَ ما بَخِلُوا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾: the sīn is for the future; «يطوقون» is a passive imperfect verb and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the relative noun «ما» is its object, and it is said [to be] genitive by a preposition, the implied form being "with what (بما)…"; the clause is resumptive; «به» is attached to the verb «بخلوا», and the wāw is its agent; «يوم» is attached to the verb «سيطوقون»; «القيامة» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «بخلوا» is the ṣila. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ مِيراثُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: the Divine Name is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ميراث»; «السموات» is muḍāf ilayhi and «الأرض» is conjoined; the clause is resumptive.
﴿وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ; «بما» is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾; the clause «تعملون» is the ṣila of the relative «ما», and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:181-182.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; «قد» is a particle of realization. ﴿سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّذِينَ قالُوا﴾: a past verb; the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent) and «قول» the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «قالوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿سَمِعَ﴾ is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism) and «فقير» as its khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِياءُ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿سَنَكْتُبُ ما قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive; «ما» is relative and the clause after it its ṣila, or it is a maṣdar-particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a direct object: "We will record their saying." ﴿وَقَتْلَهُمُ﴾: conjoined to the relative «ما» or to the interpreted maṣdar. ﴿الْأَنْبِياءَ﴾: direct object of the maṣdar «قتل». ﴿بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «قتل»; «حق» is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَنَقُولُ﴾: conjoined to «سنكتب». ﴿ذُوقُوا عَذابَ الْحَرِيقِ﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and a direct object; the clause is the speech quoted. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِما﴾: attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ﴾: a past verb; «أيديكم» is the agent, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the referring pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted: "by what your hands sent forth (بما قدمته أيديكم)." ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: anna, with the Divine Name as its noun, and the wāw is conjunctive. ﴿لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ﴾: «ليس», and the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; «ظلام» is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of laysa, whose noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form «هو» [He]; the clause ﴿لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna. ﴿لِلْعَبِيدِ﴾: attached to «ظلام».

daas-irab:183-183.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) of «الذين» in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «[لقد] سمع الله ...». ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنا﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism), and the clause «عهد إلينا» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the maṣdar-particle «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «لرسول» is attached to «نؤمن». ﴿حَتَّى يَأْتِيَنا﴾: «يأتينا» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after «حتى», and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نؤمن». ﴿بِقُرْبانٍ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿تَأْكُلُهُ النَّارُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its object and its agent; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of «قربان». ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَدْ جاءَكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِي﴾: a past verb, a direct object and the agent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of «رسل», or to the verb. ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾: attached to the verb «جاءكم»; the clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَبِالَّذِي قُلْتُمْ﴾: «بالذي» is conjoined to «بالبينات», and the clause «قلتم» is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; the lām is a preposition and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قتلتموهم»; the alif was dropped because the lām entered upon it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾: «إن» is a jussive conditional; «كنتم» is kāna and its noun, «صادقين» its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:184-185.t:
﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إن» is a jussive conditional. ﴿كَذَّبُوكَ﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «قد» is a particle of realization; and [then] a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (ṣifa) of «رسل». ﴿جاؤُ بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause is an adjective of «رسل».
﴿وَالزُّبُرِ وَالْكِتابِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الْمُنِيرِ﴾: an adjective; the clause ﴿فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «نفس» is muḍāf ilayhi, and likewise «الموت». ﴿وَإِنَّما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «إنما» is [inna with] the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿تُوَفَّوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is the deputy agent, and it is the first object. ﴿أُجُورَكُمْ﴾: second direct object. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿زُحْزِحَ﴾: a passive past verb whose deputy agent is «هو» [he]; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿عَنِ النَّارِ﴾ are attached to it.
﴿وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ﴾: conjoined to «زحزح»; a passive past verb and a second direct object, the deputy agent being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, which is the first object. ﴿فَقَدْ فازَ﴾: the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من». ﴿وَمَا الْحَياةُ الدُّنْيا إِلَّا مَتاعُ﴾: «ما» is negating; «الحياة» is the mubtadaʾ and «متاع» the khabar; «الدنيا» is an adjective of «الحياة»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْغُرُورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:186-186.t: ﴿لَتُبْلَوُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; «تبلون» is a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, [which is] dropped to avoid a succession of identical letters; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the nūn of emphasis is a particle with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي أَمْوالِكُمْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: conjoined; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath. ﴿وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ﴾: like «ولتبلون». ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: attached to the verb before them; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾: a passive past verb and the deputy agent, which is the first object, and «الكتاب» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكتاب». ﴿وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا﴾: conjoined to the clause «من الذين أوتوا الكتاب». ﴿أَذىً﴾: direct object of «لتسمعن». ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَإِنْ تَصْبِرُوا﴾: «إن» is conditional, and the imperfect verb is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا﴾: conjoined to «وتصبروا». ﴿فَإِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is connective; inna, with the demonstrative as its noun (ism). ﴿مِنْ عَزْمِ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿الْأُمُورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:187-187.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb], its implied form being "remember (اذكر)". ﴿أَخَذَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِيثاقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and «الكتاب» is the second object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; «تبيننه» is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, [which is] dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the dropped wāw is the agent and the hāʾ is a direct object. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَلا تَكْتُمُونَهُ﴾: the clause is conjoined to «لتبيننه», and «لا» is negating. ﴿فَنَبَذُوهُ وَراءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ﴾: a past verb, its agent and a direct object, and an adverb attached to the verb; «ظهورهم» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاشْتَرَوْا بِهِ ثَمَناً﴾: a past verb, its agent and a direct object, and a preposition and genitive noun attached to the verb. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَبِئْسَ ما يَشْتَرُونَ﴾: «بئس» is a past verb for expressing blame; «ما» is a complete indefinite noun (nakira tāmma), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as tamyīz (specification); the agent is the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdar-particle «ما» and the verb; the implied sense is: "wretched is this purchase of theirs." [Translator's note: so in the source, which treats «ما» both as the tamyīz and as the maṣdar-particle.]

daas-irab:188-188.t: ﴿لا تَحْسَبَنَّ﴾: «لا» is the prohibitive, jussive-making [particle]; «تحسبن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive by «لا»; the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت» [you]. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَفْرَحُونَ بِما أَتَوْا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the imperfect verb «يفرحون»; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative «الذين», and the clause «أتوا» is the ṣila of the relative «ما». ﴿وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا﴾: «ويحبون» is conjoined to «يفرحون»; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the passive imperfect verb is in the position of accusative as a direct object; and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿بِما﴾ are attached to the verb before them. ﴿لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative «ما». ﴿فَلا تَحْسَبَنَّهُمْ﴾: like «لا تحسبن» before it, and the hāʾ is a direct object. ﴿بِمَفازَةٍ﴾: attached to «تحسبنهم». ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «مفازة»; the clause «فلا تحسبنهم» is an emphasizing (muʾakkida) clause, and the fāʾ is a connective [redundant] (ṣila). ﴿وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «عذاب»; ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ is its adjective; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:189-189.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name and the preposition are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مُلْكُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «الله», the Divine Name, is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾: its khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ are attached. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:190-191.t:
﴿إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ لَآياتٍ﴾: inna and its noun (ism); «آيات» is accusative with kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and it is also said to be the lām of beginning (ibtidāʾ); «في خلق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna.
«والأرض» and «واختلاف» are conjoined. ﴿لِأُولِي الْأَلْبابِ﴾: the lām is a preposition; «أولي» is a genitive noun, [marked] with yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural, and the nūn was dropped for the genitive construct; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «آيات»; «الألباب» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) of «أولي» or an adjective. ﴿يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قِياماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقُعُوداً﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَعَلى جُنُوبِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl; the implied sense is "lying on their sides." ﴿وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: the clause is conjoined to «يذكرون». ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: a munādā (one addressed) in a genitive construct (muḍāf), accusative. ﴿ما خَلَقْتَ هذا﴾: «ما» is negating; «خلقت» is a past verb, the tāʾ is its agent and the demonstrative its object. ﴿باطِلًا﴾: an accusative ḥāl, or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a vain creation"; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "they say: Our Lord…". ﴿سُبْحانَكَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿فَقِنا عَذابَ النَّارِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition]; «ق» is a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter because its final letter is weak, and «نا» is an attached pronoun, direct object; «عذاب» is a second direct object; «النار» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.

daas-irab:192-193.t: ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: a munādā (one addressed) in a genitive construct (muḍāf). ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun (ism). ﴿مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ﴾: «من» is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; «تدخل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) with sukūn and given a kasra to prevent two quiescent letters meeting; «النار» is its object. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ is connective; «قد» is a particle of realization. ﴿أَخْزَيْتَهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a direct object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «من», and the clause ﴿مَنْ تُدْخِلِ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿وَما لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is negating; «للظالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar placed first. ﴿مِنْ أَنْصارٍ﴾: «من» is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; «أنصار» is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: it has been parsed before. ﴿إِنَّنا﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾: a past verb and its agent. ﴿مُنادِياً﴾: direct object; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿يُنادِي لِلْإِيمانِ﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of «مناديا». ﴿أَنْ آمِنُوا﴾: «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya); «آمنوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. ﴿بِرَبِّكُمْ﴾: attached to «آمنوا»; the clause is explicative. ﴿فَآمَنَّا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; «آمنا» is a past verb and its agent. ﴿فَاغْفِرْ لَنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition], and [then] a verb of supplication whose agent is latent (mustatir); «لنا» is attached to the verb. ﴿ذُنُوبَنا﴾: direct object; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئاتِنا﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتَوَفَّنا مَعَ الْأَبْرارِ﴾: «مع» is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the verb of supplication is indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and «نا» is its object; «الأبرار» is muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:194-195.t:
﴿رَبَّنا﴾: it has been parsed before. ﴿وَآتِنا ما وَعَدْتَنا عَلى رُسُلِكَ﴾: conjoined to «وتوفنا»; «ما» is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «وعدتنا» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and to this verb the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and «لا» is prohibitive. ﴿تُخْزِنا يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb of supplication, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and «نا» is a direct object; «يوم» is an adverb attached to «تخزنا». ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعادَ﴾: inna and its noun (ism), and the clause after it is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَاسْتَجابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the past verb has the preposition and genitive noun attached to it; «ربهم» is its agent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنِّي لا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عامِلٍ مِنْكُمْ﴾: anna and its noun, and the clause «لا أضيع» is its khabar; «منكم» is attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «عامل»; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «استجاب». ﴿مِنْ ذَكَرٍ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective of «عامل», or a badal (substitute). ﴿أَوْ أُنْثى﴾: conjoined. ﴿بَعْضُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is parenthetical or resumptive. ﴿فَالَّذِينَ هاجَرُوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «الذين» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «هاجروا» is its ṣila. ﴿وَأُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيارِهِمْ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined, and so is the clause ﴿وَأُوذُوا فِي سَبِيلِي﴾. ﴿وَقاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئاتِهِمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; «أكفرن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its agent is latent (mustatir); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and «سيئاتهم» is its object, accusative with kasra; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the oath with its response is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذين». ﴿وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ﴾: conjoined to «لأكفرن». ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾: a noun accusative by removal of the preposition, and the clause ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾ is an adjective. ﴿ثَواباً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or ḥāl (circumstantial), or tamyīz (specification). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective of «ثوابا», and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوابِ﴾: «الله», the Divine Name, is a mubtadaʾ; «عنده» is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ «حسن»; the nominal clause is the khabar of «الله».

daas-irab:196-197.t: ﴿لا يَغُرَّنَّكَ﴾: «لا» is the prohibitive, jussive-making [particle]; «يغرنك» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the nūn is a particle with no grammatical position, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَقَلُّبُ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي الْبِلادِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «تقلب». ﴿مَتاعٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "their living is an enjoyment…". ﴿قَلِيلٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿ثُمَّ مَأْواهُمْ﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction; «مأواهم» is a mubtadaʾ, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because [its appearance] is impossible, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَهَنَّمُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿وَبِئْسَ الْمِهادُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «بئس» is a past verb for expressing blame; «المهاد» is its agent, and the one specifically blamed (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "Hell"; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:198-199.t:
﴿لكِنِ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿رَبَّهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «الذين». ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿خالِدِينَ فِيها﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached; and likewise ﴿نُزُلًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾; it is also said that «نزلا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَما عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the adverb is attached to an omitted ṣila; «خير» is the khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun «للأبرار» are attached; the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of inna. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمَنْ﴾: the lām is of beginning (ibtidāʾ) or the shifted lām (al-muzaḥlaqa); «من» is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of inna, and the clause ﴿يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ﴾ is its ṣila. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «الله», and the clause ﴿أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ is its ṣila. ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿خاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ﴾: a ḥāl, to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يَشْتَرُونَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلًا﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); «ثمنا» is a direct object and «قليلا» an adjective; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ﴾. ﴿عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "existing with their Lord", or attached to «أجرهم». ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسابِ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun and «سريع» as its khabar, and «الحساب» is muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:200-200.t: ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: a munādā (one addressed), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) of «أي». ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اصْبِرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and likewise the clauses ﴿وَصابِرُوا﴾ ﴿وَرابِطُوا﴾ ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ conjoined to it after it. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ﴾: laʿalla and its noun (ism), and the clause after it is its khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:78-78.t:
﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقاً﴾: inna, and فريقا is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿يَلْوُونَ أَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالْكِتابِ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and ألسنتهم the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يلوون. ﴿لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl). تحسبوه: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن, its sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi; من الكتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them, and they are the second object of تحسبوه.
﴿وَما هُوَ مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ما is the Ḥijāzī negative that works like ليس; هو is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as its noun; من الكتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾: هو is mubtadaʾ (subject); من عند: attached to an omitted khabar; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and الكذب its object; the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to الكذب; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause يعلمون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم, and the clause وهم يعلمون is circumstantial.

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿ما كانَ لِبَشَرٍ﴾: ما is negative; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ يُؤْتِيَهُ اللَّهُ الْكِتابَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent) and الكتاب its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of nominative as the noun of كان; the implied form is: «ما كان إيتاء الله الكتاب والحكم والنبوة لبشر» (Allah's giving the Book, judgment and prophethood was not for a human being). ﴿وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ﴾: both conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ﴾: يقول is conjoined to يؤتيه, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يقول. ﴿كُونُوا عِباداً لِي﴾: a defective imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun and عبادا its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of عبادا. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلكِنْ كُونُوا رَبَّانِيِّينَ﴾: ولكن: the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is the lightened form, without governing effect; كونوا is a defective imperative verb, the wāw is its noun, and ربانيين is its khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: «ولكن يقول» (but he would say). ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ الْكِتابَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); كنتم is a defective past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; the verb together with the maṣdar-forming ما is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ربانيين; the implied form is: «بسبب كونكم تعلمون الكتاب» (because of your teaching the Book). ﴿تُعَلِّمُونَ الْكِتابَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar. ﴿وَبِما كُنْتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ﴾: conjoined to بما كنتم تعلمون الكتاب.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿وَلا يَأْمُرَكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is for reinforcing the negation; يأمركم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to يقول. It has also been read in the nominative, as a new (resumptive) statement. ﴿أَنْ تَتَّخِذُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأمركم. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالنَّبِيِّينَ﴾: conjoined to الملائكة, accusative like it, with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَرْباباً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَيَأْمُرُكُمْ بِالْكُفْرِ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to يأمركم. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation.

daas-irab:81-81.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb "اذكر" (remember). ﴿أَخَذَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِيثاقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَما﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ) or the lām that prepares for an oath (al-mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْتُكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ كِتابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَحِكْمَةٍ﴾: conjoined to كتاب. ﴿ثُمَّ جاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مُصَدِّقٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿لَما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مصدق. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative ما. The khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿ما﴾ is omitted, the implied form being: «الذي آتيتكم هو الحق» (what I have given you is the truth); and it has been said that the khabar is the implied oath clause together with its answer. ﴿لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of the oath understood from His saying: إذ أخذ الله ميثاق; and it has been said that the oath is implied. تؤمنن: its original form is تؤمنون, an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of dislike of a succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the ḍamma indicates it; the heavy nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تؤمنن. ﴿وَلَتَنْصُرُنَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, an omitted fāʿil, which is the wāw, and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to the clause تؤمنن, which is the answer to an implied oath; and the clause لما آتيتكم من كتاب is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), between the oath and its answer. ﴿قالَ أَأَقْرَرْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; أقررتم is a past verb and its fāʿil, and likewise ﴿وَأَخَذْتُمْ﴾. ﴿عَلى ذلِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِصْرِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person. The two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and likewise the clause ﴿أَقْرَرْنا﴾: the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَاشْهَدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), the implied form being: «إذا كنتم أقررتم فاشهدوا» (since you have affirmed, then bear witness); اشهدوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the condition clause with its answer is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the saying ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنا is mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: the text is disordered in the source; the intended sense appears to be: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, [its clause being followed by] the maqūl al-qawl; ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and أنا is mubtadaʾ.] ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿فَمَنْ تَوَلَّى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تولى is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿بَعْدَ ذلِكَ﴾: بعد is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولى; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ الْفاسِقُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, and the clause فأولئك is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis with its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ مَن.

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ اللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive; غير is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يبغون; غير is muḍāf, and دين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi; يبغون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسلم. ﴿أَسْلَمَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿طَوْعاً﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَكَرْهاً﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb يرجعون. ﴿يُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause وله أسلم.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is conjoined to الله, in the position of genitive. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَ عَلى إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْباطِ﴾: conjoined to إبراهيم. ﴿وَما أُوتِيَ﴾: أوتي is a passive past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿وَعِيسى وَالنَّبِيُّونَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتي. ﴿لا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ﴾: لا is negative; بين is an adverb of place attached to the imperfect verb نفرق; أحد is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and likewise the clause ﴿وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾.

daas-irab:85-86.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يَبْتَغِ﴾: the wāw is for resumption; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يبتغ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa). ﴿غَيْرَ الْإِسْلامِ دِيناً﴾: غير is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الإسلام is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); دينا is a tamyīz (specification). If we take the implied form to be «ومن يبتغ دينا غير الإسلام», then دينا is parsed as the mafʿūl bihi and غير as a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of دين, and when it was placed before it, it was parsed as a ḥāl. ﴿فَلَنْ يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); يقبل is a passive imperfect verb, accusative by لن, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it" (huwa); منه: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقبل; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is for resumption; هو is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الخاسرين. ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿يَهْدِي اللَّهُ قَوْماً﴾: an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil and قوما the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is a naʿt of قوما. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to كفروا. ﴿إِيمانِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَشَهِدُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). [As a conjunction,] the clause شهدوا is conjoined to the verbal meaning contained in إيمانهم, i.e. "after they had believed"; but if the wāw is circumstantial, then قد is implied after it, and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿أَنَّ الرَّسُولَ حَقٌّ﴾: anna, its noun and its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to شهدوا. ﴿وَجاءَهُمُ الْبَيِّناتُ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to شهدوا. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is for resumption; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause ﴿لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); القوم is a mafʿūl bihi, and الظالمين a naʿt.

daas-irab:87-89.t:
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جَزاؤُهُمْ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ, nominative with the ḍamma. ﴿أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ﴾: anna, and لعنة is its noun; عليهم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ جزاؤهم, and the clause ﴿جَزاؤُهُمْ﴾ is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis), genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خالدين. ﴿لا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl. ﴿وَلا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ﴾: ينظرون is a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم, and the clause ولا هم ينظرون is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا الَّذِينَ﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿تابُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تابوا. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَأَصْلَحُوا﴾: conjoined to تابوا. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غفور and رحيم are its two predicates; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, having no grammatical position.

daas-irab:90-90.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun, and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفروا. ﴿إِيمانِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ازْدادُوا كُفْراً﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); كفرا is a tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَنْ تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, accusative by لن; توبتهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُمُ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الضَّالُّونَ﴾: its khabar; and the clause هم الضالون is the khabar of the demonstrative.

daas-irab:91-91.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿وَماتُوا﴾: conjoined to كفروا. ﴿وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلَنْ يُقْبَلَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb), because of the sense of condition contained in the relative noun. ﴿يُقْبَلَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ أَحَدِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقبل. ﴿مِلْءُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ذَهَباً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَلَوِ افْتَدى بِهِ﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (li-l-iʿtirāḍ); لو is a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive; افتدى is a past verb, and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). [Translator's note: so in the source, although it has just stated that لو does not make the verb jussive.] به: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to افتدى. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: «فلن يقبل منه» (it will not be accepted from him); and لو with what follows it is a parenthetical clause.
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause لهم عذاب أليم is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَما لَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; لهم: attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ ناصِرِينَ﴾: مِن is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ناصرين is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:92-92.t: ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿تَنالُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْبِرَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تُنْفِقُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the verb and the maṣdar-forming أن implicit after حتى is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنالوا. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تنفقوا, and the clause ﴿تُحِبُّونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تُنْفِقُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنفقوا. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:93-93.t:
﴿كُلُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الطَّعامِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كانَ حِلًّا﴾: كان, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; حلا is its khabar (predicate). ﴿لِبَنِي﴾: a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, and it is muḍāf. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper noun and foreign. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā) from the implied noun of كان; and the clause ﴿حَرَّمَ إِسْرائِيلُ عَلى نَفْسِهِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) حرم. ﴿أَنْ تُنَزَّلَ﴾: أن makes the verb accusative; تنزل is a passive imperfect verb. ﴿التَّوْراةُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْراةِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e. "if you are certain of what you say, then bring"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاتْلُوها﴾: conjoined to فأتوا. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ﴾: إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; كنتم: كان and its noun; صادقين is its khabar.
The verb كان is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:94-94.t: ﴿فَمَنِ افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ﴾: the fāʾ is for resumption; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); افترى الكذب: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) افترى; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to افترى. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause هم الظالمون is the khabar of the demonstrative, and the clause فأولئك is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ مَن.

daas-irab:95-96.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿صَدَقَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاتَّبِعُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction or the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), the implied form being: «إذا أقررتم بهذا فاتبعوا ملة إبراهيم» (if you acknowledge this, then follow the creed of Abraham); اتبعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined, or the apodosis of an implied condition, having no grammatical position. ﴿مِلَّةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما كانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾: كان, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ﴾: inna and its noun, and بيت is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a passive past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); الذي is a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna; ببكة: a noun genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper noun and feminine; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مُبارَكاً﴾: a ḥāl from the relative noun. ﴿وَهُدىً﴾: conjoined. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هدى.
