daas-irab:97-97.t: ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿آياتٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَيِّناتٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿مَقامُ﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي" (they are); or a mubtadaʾ, the implied form being «منها مقام إبراهيم» (among them is the Station of Abraham); and it has been said: a badal (substitute) from آيات. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper noun and foreign; and the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَمَنْ دَخَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is for resumption; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive; دخله is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause of مَن is resumptive. ﴿كانَ آمِناً﴾: كان and its khabar, and its noun is a latent pronoun; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ مَن. [Translator's note: so in the source; كان آمنا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), while دخله is the protasis.] ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted khabar, and likewise ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾. ﴿حِجُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَنِ اسْتَطاعَ﴾: مَن is a relative noun in the position of genitive as a badal from الناس, and the clause استطاع is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استطاع. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَنْ كَفَرَ﴾: the wāw is for resumption; مَن is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ, and كفر is the protasis. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غني is its khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿عَنِ الْعالَمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غني.

daas-irab:98-99.t:
﴿قُلْ يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ﴾: the lām is a preposition; ما is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the dropped alif; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb after them; تكفرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تكفرون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and شهيد is the khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى ما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to شهيد; تعملون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿قُلْ يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَنْ آمَنَ﴾: see the i'rab of the previous ayah. من is a relative noun in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آمن is a past verb, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَبْغُونَها عِوَجاً﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi and the wāw the fāʿil; عوجا is a ḥāl; and the clause تبغونها عوجا is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ شُهَداءُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a third ḥāl. ﴿وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغافِلٍ﴾: the Ḥijāzī ما; the Name of Majesty is its noun, and its khabar is genitive in form by the redundant (zāʾida) bāʾ and accusative in position; the clause is also in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:100-100.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾: أيّ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative by the vocative يا; and ها is a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تُطِيعُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَرِيقاً﴾: its object. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فريقا. ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾: a passive past verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the first object, and the second object is الكتاب. ﴿يَرُدُّوكُمْ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa); the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb attached to كافرين or to the verb before it. ﴿إِيمانِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كافِرِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ, or a second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined with the fāʾ or with the إذا of surprise (idhā al-fujāʾiyya).

daas-irab:101-101.t: ﴿وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ﴾: كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); تكفرون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (wāw al-ḥāl). ﴿تُتْلى عَلَيْكُمْ آياتُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb; آيات is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أنتم, and the nominal clause وأنتم تتلى is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; and likewise the clause ﴿وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the preposition and its genitive noun فيكم are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ رسوله. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; مَن is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْتَصِمْ بِاللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to the imperfect verb يعتصم. ﴿فَقَدْ هُدِيَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); هدي is a passive past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ are attached, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and this apodosis with the protasis is the khabar of مَن.

daas-irab:102-103.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab was given shortly before. ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حق stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿تُقاتِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا تَمُوتُنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; تموتن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa); the omitted wāw is the fāʿil, having been dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the nūn of emphasis is a particle with no grammatical position; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاعْتَصِمُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِحَبْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اعتصموا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَلا تَفَرَّقُوا﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نعمة. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to اذكروا, the omitted one. [Translator's note: so in the source; اذكروا is in fact overt in the ayah.] ﴿كُنْتُمْ أَعْداءً﴾: كان, its noun and its khabar; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾: بين is an adverb of place attached to the verb ألف; the clause is conjoined, and likewise the clause ﴿فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ بِنِعْمَتِهِ إِخْواناً﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, because they precede it. ﴿إِخْواناً﴾: the khabar of أصبح. ﴿وَكُنْتُمْ عَلى شَفا حُفْرَةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ﴾: على شفا: attached to the omitted khabar of كنتم; من النار: attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حفرة; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿فَأَنْقَذَكُمْ مِنْها﴾ is also conjoined. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or [to] a mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ آياتِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil and آياته the mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; لكم: attached to يبين. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ﴾: laʿalla and its noun, and the clause تهتدون is its khabar; and the clause لعلكم is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).

daas-irab:104-105.t: ﴿وَلْتَكُنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command (lām al-amr); تكن is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn; it may also be parsed as defective (nāqiṣa). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكن if complete, or to its omitted khabar (predicate) if it is defective. ﴿أُمَّةٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent), or the noun of تكن. ﴿يَدْعُونَ إِلَى الْخَيْرِ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: the clause is conjoined, and likewise ﴿وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ﴾. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the nominal clause ﴿هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, the clause being the khabar of أولئك. ﴿وَلا تَكُونُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; تكونوا is a defective imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿كَالَّذِينَ﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), in the position of accusative as the khabar of تكونوا, or it is a preposition; الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿تَفَرَّقُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَاخْتَلَفُوا﴾: conjoined to تفرقوا. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اختلفوا. ﴿ما جاءَهُمُ﴾: ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); جاءهم is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْبَيِّناتُ﴾: fāʿil; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: naʿt; and the clause is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:106-107.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); some attached it to عظيم before it. ﴿تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ﴾: conjoined to it. ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is for consequential detailing (tafrīʿ); أمّا is a particle of condition, detailing and emphasis. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَكَفَرْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; كفرتم is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb attached to كفرتم. ﴿إِيمانِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl), its implied form being: «فيقال لهم» (it will be said to them); the omitted saying clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ الذين, and it is the answer of the condition أمّا. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); ذوقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: its object; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, the implied form being: «بما أنكم كفرتم فذوقوا» (since you disbelieved, then taste); and the clause فأما الذين is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun, and the clause تكفرون is its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ذوقوا. ﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ ابْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿فَفِي﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ. ﴿في رَحْمَتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the relative noun الذين. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar خالدون; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:108-109.t:
﴿تِلْكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آياتُ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نَتْلُوها﴾: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil (agent) being "we" (naḥnu); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نتلوها. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «متلبسة بالحق» (accompanied by the truth). ﴿وَمَا اللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Ḥijāzī ما; الله, the Name of Majesty, is its noun. ﴿يُرِيدُ ظُلْماً﴾: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾: a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ظُلْماً﴾; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of ما. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لله: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to ترجع.
﴿تُرْجَعُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿الْأُمُورُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:110-110.t: ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿خَيْرَ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). Some said that كان is complete (tāmma), meaning "came to be (wujida)". ﴿أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرجت; the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿تَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of accusative as a second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the tāʾ. ﴿وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ﴾: conjoined, and likewise ﴿وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿آمَنَ أَهْلُ الْكِتابِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَكانَ خَيْراً لَهُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun, the implied form being: «كان الإيمان خيرا لهم» (faith would have been better for them); خيرا is its khabar; لهم is attached to خيرا; the clause is the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive, having no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْفاسِقُونَ﴾: its khabar. Some parsed ﴿مِنْهُمُ﴾ as a mubtadaʾ, since it means "some of them", and المؤمنون as its khabar; and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:111-111.t: ﴿لَنْ﴾: a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿يَضُرُّوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِلَّا أَذىً﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; أذى is the excepted (mustathnā), accusative; the implied form is: «لن يضروكم ضررا شديدا إلا ضرر أذى» (they will not harm you with severe harm, only the harm of hurt). ﴿وَإِنْ يُقاتِلُوكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يقاتلوكم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and likewise ﴿يُوَلُّوكُمُ﴾. ﴿الْأَدْبارَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ لا يُنْصَرُونَ﴾: ثم is a conjunction, and here it conveys resumption, because the verb following it is not jussive; لا is negative; ينصرون is a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:112-112.t: ﴿ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ﴾: a passive past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); الذلة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَيْنَ ما﴾: a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the verb before it. ﴿ثُقِفُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿بِحَبْلٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied form is: «ضربت عليهم الذلة في أغلب أحوالهم إلا في حال اعتصامهم بحبل الله» (humiliation was stamped upon them in most of their states, except in the state of their holding fast to a rope from Allah). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by مِن, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حبل. ﴿وَحَبْلٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَباؤُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to ضربت. ﴿بِغَضَبٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to باءوا. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by مِن, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to a naʿt of غضب. ﴿وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَسْكَنَةُ﴾: the repeated clause is conjoined. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and anna and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar of كانوا. ﴿وَيَقْتُلُونَ الْأَنْبِياءَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb or to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿حَقٍّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِما عَصَوْا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and they are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَكانُوا يَعْتَدُونَ﴾: like كانوا يكفرون before it. The clause ذلك بأنهم is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of أينما is omitted, the implied form being: «أينما ثقفوا فقد ضربت عليهم الذلة» (wherever they are found, humiliation has been stamped upon them).

daas-irab:113-114.t: ﴿لَيْسُوا سَواءً﴾: ليس, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُمَّةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قائِمَةٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿يَتْلُونَ آياتِ اللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آناءَ﴾: an adverb attached to يتلون. ﴿اللَّيْلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause يتلون is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of أمة, and the clause أمة قائمة is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ﴾: هم is mubtadaʾ, and the clause يسجدون is its khabar; the clause وهم يسجدون is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun, consisting of the Name of Majesty and the preposition, are attached to يؤمنون; the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of أمة. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾: naʿt. ﴿وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined, and like it in this are the two clauses ﴿وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ، وَيُسارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْراتِ﴾. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:115-115.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَفْعَلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلَنْ يُكْفَرُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; يكفروه is a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and عليم the khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:116-117.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوالُهُمْ وَلا أَوْلادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئاً﴾: for its i'rab see ayah no. 10 of this surah. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ أَصْحابُ النَّارِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); النار is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to the clause لن تغني. ﴿هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the clause is a second khabar of أولئك.
[Translator's note: in the source the remainder of this entry (ayah 117) is typographically corrupted: the opening ﴿ brackets and the first letters of the Quranic words are missing. The Quranic words are restored below in brackets from the ayah; the analysis is translated as written.]
[﴿مَثَلُ﴾]: mubtadaʾ. [﴿ما يُنْفِقُونَ﴾]: ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative; ينفقون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). [﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾]: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينفقون. [﴿الْحَياةِ﴾]: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, genitive. [﴿الدُّنْيا﴾]: a naʿt (adjective) of الحياة. [﴿كَمَثَلِ﴾]: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ مثل. [﴿رِيحٍ﴾]: muḍāf ilayhi. [﴿فِيها﴾]: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar. [﴿صِرٌّ﴾]: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of ريح. [﴿أَصابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍ﴾]: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a muḍāf ilayhi; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine; the clause is a second naʿt of ريح. [﴿ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾]: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt of قوم. [﴿فَأَهْلَكَتْهُ﴾]: the clause is conjoined. [﴿وَما ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾]: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; ظلمهم is a past verb and the hāʾ is its object, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [﴿وَلكِنْ﴾]: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) without governing effect. [﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾]: a fronted mafʿūl bihi. [﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾]: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:118-118.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿لا تَتَّخِذُوا بِطانَةً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and بطانة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ دُونِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بطانة; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿لا يَأْلُونَكُمْ﴾: لا is negative; يألونكم is an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَبالًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; and it has been said: a tamyīz (specification); the clause is a naʿt of بطانة. ﴿وَدُّوا ما عَنِتُّمْ﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); عنتم is a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, the implied form being: «ودوا عنتكم» (they wished your distress); the clause is a second naʿt of بطانة. ﴿قَدْ بَدَتِ الْبَغْضاءُ مِنْ أَفْواهِهِمْ﴾: قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is a third naʿt of بطانة. ﴿وَما تُخْفِي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تخفي is an imperfect verb. ﴿صُدُورُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of ما; and the clause ﴿وَما تُخْفِي صُدُورُهُمْ﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realization. ﴿بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْآياتِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بينا. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم: كان and its noun, and its khabar is the clause تعقلون; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:1-4.t:
﴿الم﴾: for its i'rab see the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara. ﴿اللَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ﴾: for its i'rab see verse 254 of al-Baqara. [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase was parsed at al-Baqara 255.]
﴿نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتابَ﴾: a past verb and its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he". ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الكتاب. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿لِما﴾: ما is a relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدقا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ التَّوْراةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ﴾: conjoined to أنزل الكتاب. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل; قبل is indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the construct, the implied form being: "from before that". ﴿هُدىً لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a ḥāl from التوراة and الإنجيل, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) هدى. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ الْفُرْقانَ﴾: conjoined to ﴿أَنْزَلَ التَّوْراةَ﴾. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآياتِ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun; the verbal clause كفروا is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُمْ عَذابٌ شَدِيدٌ﴾: عذاب is mubtadaʾ (subject) and شديد is an adjective (ṣifa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and عزيز is the khabar. ﴿ذُو﴾: a second khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿انْتِقامٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-6.t:
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لا يَخْفى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ﴾: لا is negating; يخفى is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; شيء is its fāʿil (agent); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخفى.
﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of شيء. ﴿وَلا فِي السَّماءِ﴾: conjoined to في الأرض.
﴿هُوَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿يُصَوِّرُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الْأَرْحامِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصوركم; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: a conditional particle, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾: العزيز is the first khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He is the Mighty", and الحكيم is a second khabar.

daas-irab:7-7.t:
﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتابَ﴾: هو is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the relative noun is khabar (predicate); the clause أنزل عليك الكتاب is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿آياتٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُحْكَماتٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتابِ﴾: هن is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; أم is its khabar and الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is an adjective of آيات. ﴿وَأُخَرُ مُتَشابِهاتٌ﴾: conjoined to آيات محكمات and parsed like it. ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; أما is a conditional particle. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿زَيْغٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَيَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); يتبعون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of the relative noun الذين, and it stands in place of the apodosis. ﴿ما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil being latent (mustatir). ﴿تَشابَهَ مِنْهُ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تشابه; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿الْفِتْنَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَابْتِغاءَ تَأْوِيلِهِ﴾: conjoined to ابتغاء الفتنة. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating. ﴿يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); الله, the Name of Majesty, is the fāʿil. ﴿وَالرَّاسِخُونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; الراسخون is conjoined to الله, nominative with wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, or it is a mubtadaʾ if the wāw is parsed as resumptive. ﴿فِي الْعِلْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الراسخون. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الراسخون, or it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الراسخون. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنا; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar.
﴿رَبِّنا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَما يَذَّكَّرُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negating; يذكر is an imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿أُولُوا﴾: fāʿil, nominative with wāw because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl clause.

daas-irab:8-9.t: ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct, accusative (manṣūb); نا is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنا﴾: تزغ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta); قلوبنا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تزغ. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هَدَيْتَنا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهَبْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿هَبْ﴾: a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to هب. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to هب or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾, which is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject) or badal (substitute). ﴿الْوَهَّابُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أنت; the nominal clause ﴿أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ﴾ is the khabar of inna; and the clause ﴿إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ ... ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed. ﴿إِنَّكَ جامِعُ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جامع. ﴿لا رَيْبَ﴾: the lā of generic negation. ﴿رَيْبَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of lā; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of يوم. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعادَ﴾: inna, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause لا يخلف الميعاد is its khabar. And the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ ... ﴾ is causal.

daas-irab:10-11.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوالُهُمْ﴾: لن is a particle that makes the verb subjunctive; تغني is an imperfect verb in the accusative (subjunctive); عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغني; أموالهم is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَلا أَوْلادُهُمْ﴾: conjoined to أموالهم. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by من; the two are attached to تغني.
﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَقُودُ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿هُمْ وَقُودُ﴾ is the khabar of أولئك; and the clause ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَدَأْبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: "their way is like the way of the people of Pharaoh". ﴿آلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with fatḥa in place of kasra, a diptote because it is a proper name and foreign. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; الذين is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كذبوا; the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from آل فرعون.
﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أخذهم; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿شَدِيدُ﴾: khabar. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:12-13.t:
﴿قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: قل is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قل; the clause is resumptive, and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَتُغْلَبُونَ﴾: the sīn is for the future; تغلبون is a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَتُحْشَرُونَ﴾: conjoined to تغلبون; the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلى جَهَنَّمَ﴾: جهنم is a noun, genitive (majrūr) with fatḥa in place of kasra because it is a proper name and foreign; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحشرون.
﴿وَبِئْسَ الْمِهادُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) verb for expressing blame, and المهاد is its nominative fāʿil; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "Hell", and it is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the clause بئس المهاد, according to the most preferred view. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿آيَةٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿فِي فِئَتَيْنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿الْتَقَتا﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine, given a fatḥa because it is joined to the quiescent alif of the dual, and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فِئَةٌ﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "the first is a party".
﴿تُقاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective of فئة. ﴿وَأُخْرى كافِرَةٌ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخرى is conjoined to فئة; كافرة is an adjective. ﴿يَرَوْنَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِثْلَيْهِمْ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿رَأْيَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿الْعَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective of أخرى. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: يؤيد is an imperfect verb, and the relative noun من is its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤيد; the clause is the khabar; and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِأُولِي الْأَبْصارِ﴾: in لعبرة the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and عبرة is the postponed noun of inna; في ذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of inna; in لأولي the lām is a preposition, and أولي is a noun genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural; الأبصار is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَواتِ﴾: زين is a passive past verb; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) زين; حب is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الشهوات is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ النِّساءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الشهوات. ﴿وَالْبَنِينَ﴾: conjoined to النساء, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالْقَناطِيرِ﴾: conjoined to البنين. ﴿الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مِنَ الذَّهَبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المقنطرة. ﴿وَالْفِضَّةِ وَالْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالْأَنْعامِ وَالْحَرْثِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَتاعُ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective of الحياة, genitive; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: الله, the Name of Majesty, is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ ﴿حُسْنُ﴾. ﴿الْمَآبِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause ﴿عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الْمَآبِ﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله, and the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ ... ﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta). ﴿أَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; أنبئكم is an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِخَيْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; they are the second object. ﴿مِنْ ذلِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) خير. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَنَّاتٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾ is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective of جنات. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدين. ﴿وَأَزْواجٌ﴾: conjoined to جنات. ﴿مُطَهَّرَةٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَرِضْوانٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: conjoined to أزواج. ﴿وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and بصير is the khabar. ﴿بِالْعِبادِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصير.

daas-irab:16-17.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) from الذين in the previous verse, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being:
"they". ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā). ﴿إِنَّنا آمَنَّا﴾: inna, and نا is its noun, and the verbal clause آمنا is its khabar. ﴿فَاغْفِرْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and اغفر is a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اغفر. ﴿ذُنُوبَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition. ﴿وَقِنا﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is "you" (anta), نا is the first mafʿūl bihi, and عذاب is the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الصَّابِرِينَ﴾: a badal from الذين, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, or a noun made accusative for praise by an omitted verb; and the nouns ﴿الصَّادِقِينَ وَالْقانِتِينَ وَالْمُنْفِقِينَ وَالْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ﴾ are conjoined to الصابرين. ﴿بِالْأَسْحارِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المستغفرين.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿شَهِدَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾: anna and its noun; and the clause ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾ [is its khabar (predicate)] — هو is tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar — and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) شهد. [Translator's note: the bracketed words "is its khabar" are added for clarity; the source leaves the clause's function implicit.] ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿وَأُولُوا﴾: conjoined to الملائكة, nominative (marfūʿ) with wāw because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿قائِماً﴾: an accusative (manṣūb) ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾: two khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "Allah is the Mighty, the Wise". ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بقائما﴾.

daas-irab:119-119.t: ﴿ها﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُولاءِ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿تُحِبُّونَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَلا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْكِتابِ كُلِّهِ﴾: كله is a tawkīd (emphasis); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the imperfect verb تؤمنون before them; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِذا لَقُوكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is an adverb for future time, attached to قالوا; لقوكم is a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). And the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book treats such a clause as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).] ﴿وَ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿خَلَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَضُّوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عضوا. ﴿الْأَنامِلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْغَيْظِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted tamyīz (specification), i.e. «حقدا من الغيظ» (rancour out of rage). ﴿قُلْ مُوتُوا بِغَيْظِكُمْ﴾: the clause موتوا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿مُوتُوا﴾: an imperative and its fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِغَيْظِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to موتوا. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم is its khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:120-120.t: ﴿إِنْ تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ﴾: the conditional إن, and the imperfect verb is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its object and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). تسؤهم: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَفْرَحُوا بِها﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and it is like it. ﴿وَإِنْ تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا﴾: the conditional إن, and the imperfect verb is the protasis, and the wāw is its fāʿil; تتقوا is conjoined to تصبروا. ﴿لا يَضُرُّكُمْ﴾: لا is negative; يضركم is an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, given a ḍamma to follow the vowel of the ḍād, since it is a doubled verb (muḍaʿʿaf); the kāf is its object. ﴿كَيْدُهُمْ﴾: its fāʿil. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause ﴿تَسُؤْهُمْ﴾ has no grammatical position, as it is not joined with the fāʾ, and the clauses after it are conjoined to it. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِما يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ﴾: inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and محيط is its khabar (predicate); the clause يعملون is the ṣila (relative clause), and the preposition and its genitive noun بما are attached to (mutaʿalliq) محيط.

daas-irab:121-121.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿غَدَوْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb. It has also been said that غدوت is defective (nāqiṣa). The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقاعِدَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its two objects; the fāʿil is "you" (anta), referring to the Messenger, Allah's blessings be upon him; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِلْقِتالِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مقاعد: "positions designated for fighting". ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), with its two predicates; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:122-122.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb, a badal (substitute) from the first إذ. ﴿هَمَّتْ طائِفَتانِ﴾: همّ is a past verb; طائفتان is the fāʿil (agent), nominative with the alif because it is a dual; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائفتان. ﴿أَنْ تَفْشَلا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdar-forming particle أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to همت. ﴿وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُما﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and وليهما its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يتوكل. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of an implied jussive-making condition, having no grammatical position; and it has been said that the fāʾ is a conjunction.

daas-irab:123-124.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the answer of an oath; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); and a past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the kāf is its object and the Name of Majesty its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the Name of Majesty its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ﴾: laʿalla and its noun, and the clause تشكرون is its khabar; the clause لعلكم is causal (taʿlīliyya), having no grammatical position.
﴿إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: إذ is an adverb, a badal (substitute) from the إذ before it; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقول. ﴿أَلَنْ يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَنْ يُمِدَّكُمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; يكفيكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, and the kāf is its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the accusative-making أن and the imperfect verb يمدكم is in the position of nominative as its fāʿil. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾: the fāʿil of يمدكم; and the clause ألن is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِثَلاثَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يمددكم. ﴿آلافٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ثلاثة آلاف. ﴿مُنْزَلِينَ﴾: a second naʿt, genitive with the yāʾ.

daas-irab:125-126.t:
﴿بَلى﴾: a particle of answer. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَصْبِرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the two clauses ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا، وَيَأْتُوكُمْ﴾ are conjoined to تصبروا and are like it in i'rab. ﴿مِنْ فَوْرِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتوكم. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of فورهم; and the clause إن تصبروا is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِخَمْسَةِ آلافٍ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ﴾: like يمددكم ربكم بثلاثة.
﴿وَما جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; and a past verb, the hāʾ being its object and the Name of Majesty its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿بُشْرى﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بشرى. ﴿وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُمْ بِهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); تطمئن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to بشرى; قلوبكم is the fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تطمئن. ﴿وَمَا النَّصْرُ﴾: ما is negative; النصر is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word in the ayah is genitive, اللَّهِ.] ﴿الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ﴾: two naʿts of الله; and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:127-127.t: ﴿لِيَقْطَعَ﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); يقطع is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb نصركم (He gave you victory). ﴿طَرَفاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طرفا, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to يقطع. ﴿فَيَنْقَلِبُوا خائِبِينَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative, accusative by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and خائبين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:128-129.t: ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿شَيْءٌ﴾: the postponed noun of ليس; the clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿أَوْ يَتُوبَ﴾: أو is a conjunction; يتوب is conjoined to ليقطع; and it has been said that it is accusative by an implicit أن after أو; the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (huwa). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوب. ﴿أَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to أو يتوب. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ ظالِمُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is causal, having no grammatical position. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the imperfect verb يغفر; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila of the relative من. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause يشاء is the ṣila. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ ﴿غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and غفور and رحيم are its two predicates; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:130-132.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has already been given. ﴿لا تَأْكُلُوا الرِّبَوا﴾: the prohibitive lā; تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, with its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿أَضْعافاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مُضاعَفَةً﴾: naʿt (adjective); and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the Name of Majesty its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ﴾: laʿalla and its noun, and the clause تفلحون is its khabar (predicate); the clause لعلكم is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ﴾: like واتقوا الله. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as a naʿt. ﴿أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾: a passive past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb أعدت.
﴿وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالرَّسُولَ﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ﴾: like لعلكم تفلحون.

daas-irab:133-134.t: ﴿وَسارِعُوا إِلى مَغْفِرَةٍ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مغفرة. ﴿وَجَنَّةٍ﴾: conjoined to مغفرة. ﴿عَرْضُهَا السَّماواتُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالْأَرْضُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: a passive past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it" (hiya); the clause is the second naʿt of جنة, and the clause عرضها السموات is the first naʿt. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as a naʿt of المتقين. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي السَّرَّاءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينفقون. ﴿وَالضَّرَّاءِ﴾: conjoined; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْكاظِمِينَ﴾: conjoined to الذين, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْغَيْظَ﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle الكاظمين. ﴿وَالْعافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ﴾: conjoined to الكاظمين, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the active participle العافين. ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and the clause يحب المحسنين is its khabar; the clause والله يحب is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).

daas-irab:135-135.t:
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to the الذين before it. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for the future. ﴿فَعَلُوا فاحِشَةً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ﴾: a past verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the Name of Majesty the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إذ, having no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source, "إذ"; the conditional adverb in the ayah is إذا.] ﴿فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يغفر الذنوب is its khabar (predicate); إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in يغفر, nominative with the ḍamma. [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word in the ayah is nominative, اللَّهُ, as the analysis itself states.] The clause ومن يغفر is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
﴿وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يصروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلى ما فَعَلُوا﴾: ما is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يصروا. ﴿وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause يعلمون is the khabar of هم.

daas-irab:136-136.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address. ﴿جَزاؤُهُمْ﴾: a second mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the mubtadaʾ and khabar جزاؤهم مغفرة are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, and the clause أولئك جزاؤهم is the khabar of الذين. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of مغفرة. ﴿وَجَنَّاتٌ﴾: conjoined to مغفرة. ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and الأنهار is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of جنات. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خالدين. ﴿وَنِعْمَ﴾: a past verb for expressing praise. ﴿أَجْرُ﴾: its fāʿil. ﴿الْعامِلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:137-138.t: ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلت. ﴿سُنَنٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَسِيرُوا﴾: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb, the wāw being its fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سيروا; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, having no grammatical position. ﴿فَانْظُروا﴾: like فسيروا, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾: كان and its noun, and المكذبين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause كيف كان is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb before it. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَيانٌ﴾: its khabar. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) بيان, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَهُدىً وَمَوْعِظَةٌ﴾: conjoined to بيان. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to موعظة, or to its omitted naʿt; and the clause هذا بيان is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).

daas-irab:139-140.t:
﴿وَلا تَهِنُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تهنوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined, and likewise ﴿وَلا تَحْزَنُوا﴾. ﴿وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ﴾: أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject); الأعلون is its khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the conditional إن, and كان, its noun and its khabar; the verb كان is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿إِنْ يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ﴾: the conditional إن, and the imperfect verb is the protasis, and قرح is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَقَدْ مَسَّ الْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ﴾: قد is for realization (taḥqīq); مس القوم: a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being postponed; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿مِثْلُهُ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of قرح; and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: «فلا تيأسوا» (so do not despair). ﴿وَتِلْكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; تلك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْأَيَّامُ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿نُداوِلُها بَيْنَ النَّاسِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir); بين is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and الناس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause تلك الأيام is resumptive. ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); يعلم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَتَّخِذَ﴾: conjoined to ليعلم. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتخذ. ﴿شُهَداءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يحب الظالمين is its khabar; the clause والله لا يحب is resumptive, causal (taʿlīliyya) or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya).

daas-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إِنَّ الدِّينَ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْإِسْلامُ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَمَا اخْتَلَفَ الَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, ما is negating, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اختلف. ﴿مَا﴾: the maṣdar-particle. ﴿جاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil.
And the maṣdar-particle ما with the verb is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَغْياً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to بغيا. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَكْفُرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm). ﴿بِآياتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يكفر. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿سَرِيعُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
And the clause ﴿وَمَنْ ... ﴾ is resumptive. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of من.

daas-irab:20-20.t:
﴿فَإِنْ حَاجُّوكَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; حاجوك is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَقُلْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قل is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you" (anta); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and وجهي is mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسلمت; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وَمَنِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a relative noun, conjoined to the tāʾ in أسلمت. ﴿اتَّبَعَنِ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa; the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause قل is conjoined to فقل. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قل; and the clause ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْأُمِّيِّينَ﴾: conjoined to الذين, genitive (majrūr) with yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَأَسْلَمْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; أسلمتم is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿أَسْلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis. ﴿فَقَدِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); and the clause ﴿اهْتَدَوْا﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾: conjoined to إن أسلموا. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ is linking; إنما is innamā, a restraining particle and the particle it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبادِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and بصير is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:21-22.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the Name of Majesty الله is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَيَقْتُلُونَ النَّبِيِّينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with yāʾ, being a sound masculine plural. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقتلون. ﴿حَقٍّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَقْتُلُونَ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being: "guiding, from among the people". ﴿فَبَشِّرْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer to the relative noun because of the conditional meaning it contains; بشرهم is an imperative verb, the hāʾ is its object, and the fāʿil is "you" (anta). ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بشرهم. ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the verbal clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, khabar; and the clause ﴿حَبِطَتْ أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حبطت. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَما لَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating, or the Ḥijāzī mā that operates like laysa. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ ناصِرِينَ﴾: من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿ناصِرِينَ﴾: the postponed noun of mā; it is a noun genitive in form with yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural, and nominative in position.

daas-irab:23-24.t:
﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; لم is a particle of negation, jussive mood and conversion (to past meaning); تر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (anta). ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تر. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿نَصِيباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of نصيبا. ﴿يُدْعَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿إِلى كِتابِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدعون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيَحْكُمَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the verb يحكم and the an latent after the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يدعون. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to يحكم.
And the clause يدعون is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّى فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾: ثم is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to فريق; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ قالُوا﴾: anna and its noun, and the clause قالوا is its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar formed from anna, its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element, the implied form being: "that turning away is because of their saying". ﴿لَنْ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ﴾: the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); تمسنا is an imperfect verb, its object and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَيَّاماً﴾: an adverb of time, attached to تمسنا. ﴿مَعْدُوداتٍ﴾: an adjective of أياما, accusative with kasra in place of fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَغَرَّهُمْ فِي دِينِهِمْ﴾: a past verb, and the hāʾ is its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to this verb. ﴿ما كانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ﴾: ما is a relative noun, fāʿil; كان and its noun, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); and the clause يفترون is the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar (predicate) if the omitted element is taken to be a noun; but if it is supposed to be a verb, then it is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: ﴿فكيف يعملون ... ﴾ ("then how will they act ..."). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "then how will their state be when ...?" ﴿جَمَعْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جمعناهم. ﴿لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation; ريب is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa; فيه is attached to the khabar; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of يوم. ﴿وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine; كل is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and نفس is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause لا يظلمون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم; and the clause ﴿هُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl.
